title: Technical Support Specialist , UK
description:
Nash is looking for a Technical Support Specialist to join our global, 24/7 Technical Support team. This role sits at the heart of how Nash stabilizes the platform for our enterprise merchants - owning the investigation, resolution, and clean escalation of complex platform and integration issues across our delivery orchestration system.

Technical Support is Nash's intake and stabilization layer for everything beyond high-volume delivery inquiries. You'll be the person customers and internal teams rely on when something unusual is happening on the platform: a stuck integration, an unexpected provider behavior, a configuration question that needs real investigation. You'll resolve what you can, escalate what you can't with the context needed to move quickly, and help build the knowledge base that makes the next occurrence faster.

This is a role for someone who enjoys the detective work of complex, ambiguous technical problems, communicates clearly under pressure, and takes ownership seriously.

LOCATION

Remote in UK (required)

UK Time (GMT / BST): Thursday - Monday, 9A - 6P

TRAINING

4 weeks, Monday - Friday

A note on location

This is a remote role, but candidates must be located in the UK. This is a hard requirement driven by contractual data access obligations with our enterprise customers, not a preference - we are not able to make exceptions.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Platform and integration investigation. Diagnose configuration questions, known error patterns, API and webhook issues, and account-specific behavior across the Nash platform.

  • Escalation quality. When an issue needs Engineering or Enterprise Operations, you own the handoff — clear reproduction steps, investigation performed, impact assessment, and severity. Escalations from this team are expected to be actionable on arrival.

  • Knowledge base contribution. Document resolution patterns for novel issues so the next occurrence becomes a known pattern. Your work directly reduces future escalation volume.

  • Overflow support. Act as overflow for Delivery Support during peak windows when issues exceed their scope.

title: Service Desk/System Administrator
description:
What this role actually is

This is a hands-on operational role. Your customers are our employees. The work is a mix of live support, access administration, endpoint and MDM management, onboarding and offboarding, equipment logistics, and documentation, plus improving those processes so the same problems stop coming back.

You will own requests end-to-end rather than passing them along, work directly with non-technical colleagues, and handle several things at once on a busy day. Routine service work is a permanent part of the job, not a temporary phase before something else.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own employee IT requests end-to-end: prioritize by impact and urgency, keep people informed, resolve, document, and prevent recurrence.

  • Administer user accounts, permissions, and access across Google Workspace, Atlassian, GitHub, and AWS, applying least privilege.

  • Own IT equipment procurement, delivery, returns, and inventory accuracy for employees across supported locations, including international shipping and vendor coordination.

  • Maintain IT documentation, knowledge-base articles, and asset records so support does not depend on one person being online.

  • Reduce repetitive work through practical scripting and automation, and improve support processes without weakening security controls.

  • Enforce IT security and access policies; recognize and escalate suspicious activity and access gaps.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in IT support, Service Desk, or system administration, with personal ownership of the areas above (not adjacent exposure while other teams handled them).

  • Practical experience supporting macOS in a production employee environment.

  • Administration of Google Workspace, plus at least two of: Atlassian, GitHub access management, or cloud IAM (AWS / GCP / Azure).

  • Demonstrated ownership of access lifecycle - joiners, movers, leavers - including approval flows and least-privilege practice.

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Empathetic Engagement: Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.
  • True Ownership: Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.
  • Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance: Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.
  • Knowledge Advocacy: Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.

title: Mortgage Loan Officer (MLO)
description:
PLEASE NOTE: Open to remote candidates; however, occasional travel to Charlotte may be required.

The Position

As LendingTree's Utah Lending Manager, you will be an addition to the legal department supporting the business licensing function.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain the Utah Lending Manager license.
  • Complete the required annual Continuing Education.
  • Maintain communication with the legal department.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older.
  • The applicant has never had a loan originator license revoked in any governmental jurisdiction.
  • Must not have been convicted of, or pled guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony in a domestic, foreign, or military court--
    • During the 7-year period preceding the date of the application for licensing and registration; or
    • At any time preceding such date of application, if such felony involved an act of fraud, dishonesty, or a breach of trust, or money laundering.
  • Must demonstrate financial responsibility, character, and general fitness to determine that the loan originator will operate honestly, fairly, and efficiently within the purposes of this title.
  • Holds an active Mortgage Loan Originator license.
  • Within the past 5 years, must have at least 3 years active full time licensed lending experience and a minimum of 45 first lien residential mortgages.

Why Join Us

By joining our team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to work in a dynamic fintech environment, collaborating with talented professionals while playing a pivotal role in ensuring compliance excellence. If you’re passionate about combining regulatory expertise with creative problem-solving and enjoy working in a fast-paced innovation-driven industry, this position is for you.

ABOUT LENDINGTREE

LendingTree is the nation’s leading online lending marketplace. We connect consumers with multiple lenders so they can easily compare options and find the right fit — from mortgages and personal loans to credit, savings, and insurance products.

Our founder, Doug Lebda, started LendingTree in 1996 after his own frustrating house-hunting experience. What began as a simple idea to make loan shopping easier has grown into a platform that empowers millions of people to make smarter financial decisions every day.

What else you should know:

  • We’re a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: TREE).
  • We’ve welcomed several other companies into the LendingTree family to expand our reach and capabilities.
  • We’ve built the LendingTree app and My LendingTree dashboard to give consumers tools to manage

title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer (TypeScript)
location: Canada,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Portugal,  Spain,  UK
description:

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

title: Deployment Strategist, APAC
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

At TRM Labs, our Deployment Strategy team is on the front lines of customer experience – bridging product expertise with exceptional customer support. The team ensures our customers receive timely, accurate, and high-quality assistance at every step. You will work daily with leading financial institutions, crypto exchanges, and regulators — providing value through expert guidance, responsive support, and trusted partnership.

As a Deployment Strategist (APAC), you will play a critical role in helping TRM customers realise the full value of our platform. You will partner with regulators, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to operationalize scalable compliance programs and disrupt financial crime across the crypto ecosystem. You will manage a portfolio of strategic accounts, driving adoption of TRM's tools, and ensuring customers achieve measurable, long-term impact.

The impact you will have:

  • Act as a trusted advisor, enabling regulators, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to maximise the effectiveness of our platform within their supervisory, risk, and compliance functions.

  • Confidently explain complex technical and investigative concepts, supporting customer teams in interpreting blockchain data, building cases, and conducting financial crime investigations.

  • Build and deliver product demonstrations tailored to compliance officers, analysts, supervisors, and risk teams across financial institutions, crypto businesses, and regulatory bodies.

  • Conduct structured training sessions, delivered in English and Mandarin, to ensure TRM is embedded into customers' day-to-day investigative and compliance programs.

  • Serve as the "Voice of the Customer" by channeling customer feedback to product and engineering teams to influence product direction.

  • Monitor customer engagement and usage trends, proactively identifying early signals of churn risk and implementing effective mitigation strategies.

  • Establish a consistent engagement cadence with customer stakeholders to understand institutional priorities, regulatory obligations, and emerging risks.

  • Proactively identify and surface expansion opportunities and growth signals within customer accounts and partnering with Account Directors to drive TRM's Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets.

Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com, saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

Learn more at www.ada.cx.

You'll make sure they're getting real results from Ada, catch risk early, and run renewals from start to finish. title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Engineering - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

At Ashby,

title: Product Support Specialist - Americas
description:
Hello! We're Jason and Charlie, Support Managers at Ashby. We’re excited to share that we're hiring Product Support Specialists in North America.

Over the past few years, we’ve built a team of Ashby experts who delight customers through keen attention to detail, deep product knowledge, and fast, thoughtful support. By joining the team, you’ll contribute to delivering that same world-class experience.

In this role, you’ll work closely with customers every day. Ashby is a broad and complex product, so you can expect to handle everything from troubleshooting sophisticated integrations to guiding customers through detailed workflows and best practices.

You’ll also spend time on projects that make the work we do better. Past projects our team has taken on include:

  • Absorbing and synthesizing highly technical work from our Engineering Team to create enablement for technical up-leveling of the broader Support Team.

  • Developing workflow automation allowing for better team cohesion and efficacy.

As a company, we value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication. These and other values, which we’ll explore more deeply during the interview process, guide how we work.

You should apply if:

  • You are already comfortable owning complex SaaS troubleshooting from first report through resolution, including isolating configuration issues, reproducing ambiguous behavior, and communicating clearly

  • You can explain technical issues concisely, you think systematically, and operate with strong ownership in asynchronous environments. You can explain the same issue differently depending on the audience, while staying clear and direct.

  • You’re curious—both when addressing customers and when creating solutions that improve our workflows. You seek the answers beyond what’s on the surface.

  • You delight customers. You possess keen attention to detail, ensure your responses are thorough and clear, and are empathetic along the way.

  • You can balance investigation, customer communication, and escalation quality in a fast-moving environment.

  • You've done B2B support across company sizes, from SMB to enterprise.

You should not apply if:

  • Your recent experience is primarily customer success management, account management, or customer onboarding

  • You're more drawn to coordination, enablement, or team leadership than spending your days deep in tickets.

  • You avoid getting in the weeds of solving technical problems; each member of our support team is highly technical and capable of solving deeply complex tickets.

title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. title: (Senior) Inside Sales Specialist (m/w/d) / Technischer Vertriebsinnendienst – Pumpentechnik | Maschinenbau | DACH
description:
Wir suchen Verstärkung – Willkommen bei MUNSCH!

Bringen Sie Technik, Kundenanforderungen und Vertriebserfolg zusammen.

Die MUNSCH Chemie‑Pumpen GmbH steht seit über 60 Jahren für innovative Pumpenlösungen aus Kunststoff für die Chemie- und Industriebranche. Von dem Standort in Ransbach‑Baumbach bei Koblenz aus entwickeln und produzieren wir weltweit eingesetzte Pumpen für anspruchsvolle, korrosive und toxische Flüssigkeiten.

Bei uns erwarten Sie spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen, internationalen Umfeld – in einem Familienunternehmen, das hochwertige Produkte, Qualität, moderne Prozesse, kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung sowie Verbesserung & Teamgeist lebt.

Werden Sie Teil eines wachstumsorientierten Unternehmens, das Technik begeistert und Lösungen für die Zukunft schafft!

Als erfahrener Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im technischen Vertriebsinnendienst bzw. Backoffice übernehmen Sie bei uns eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Kunden, Außendienst und Produktion. title: Product Manager
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Deployment & Runtime Environments
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. We own how software gets packaged, deployed, and executed onboard: from the tool that assembles and maintains mission-specific software stacks, to the Runtime Container Environment that lets partner and customer workloads run securely in orbit, to the Linux infrastructure that makes it all reliable. As more satellite programs come online and as we open our container runtime to a growing number of external workloads, the team’s scope is expanding fast.

We’re looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who digs into an unfamiliar system, maps it out, and gets it shipped without needing the path handed to them. You’ll move between Linux internals, container runtimes, and CI pipelines, sometimes in the same afternoon.


About this role:
  • Contribute to and evolve our bundle management tool — the tool that resolves package dependencies, assembles mission-specific software stacks, and enables the Solutions team to spin up and maintain an ever-growing number of satellite programs
  • Develop and harden our onboard Linux infrastructure: how services are deployed on the rootfs, what system manages their execution, and how we ensure reliable and recoverable Linux operation in orbit
  • Evolve our Runtime Container Environment — the container manager and the full stack around it (base images, container registry service) — enabling partner and customer work

You'll also lead and develop a team of junior and mid-level compliance officers — coaching them, reviewing their work, and helping them grow. Your expertise across AML/CFT, sanctions, and regulatory advisory will set the standard for how the team operates and how compliance is embedded across Mollie.

Dette er en bransje som står overfor store endringer som blant annet høyere kostnader, regulatoriske endringer og ikke minst det grønne skiftet. Stillingen går under avdeling Customers & Growth, som består av 12 engasjerte kollegaer i kommersielle og operasjonelle roller. Du blir del av et CSM-team sammen med 3 kolleger og vil ha reell mulighet til å videre påvirke både Customer Success-arbeidet og produktet vårt. Today hundreds of organisations, from Swedish municipalities to global enterprises, use our platform to design compensation structures, run pay equity analysis, communicate pay to managers and employees, and report under pay transparency regulation.  The EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU 2023/970) had a transposition deadline of 7 June 2026. title: International Relationship Manager
description: Job Description    Managing a portfolio of international corporate clients is demanding work - and it matters. In Global Subsidiaries Finland, you will work at the center of cross-border business relationships, connecting clients with the right colleagues and solutions at the right time. This role offers real responsibility, close access to senior bankers, and genuine room to grow.    What You Will Be Doing   You will join an experienced and supportive team based in Helsinki, focused on serving international Business Customer and Large Corporate and Institutional clients across Finland. The team works in a collaborative and straightforward manner, drawing on specialists in financing, Cash Management, Trade Finance, and FX to deliver for clients. You will manage your own client portfolio with a good degree of autonomy, while staying well connected to senior bankers and product specialists across the bank.  More specifically, you will:    Manage and grow a portfolio of international BC and LC&I clients  Anticipate client needs, spot business opportunities, and address risks early  Collaborate with senior bankers and specialists across financing, Cash Management, Trade Finance, and FX  Guide client matters from the initial discussion through to execution and follow-up  Acquire new clients and contribute to the growth of the business     About You     At least few years of experience in corporate banking, finance, or a relevant advisory role  Strong integrity and sound judgement, particularly when decisions are not straightforward  Good understanding of credit and a genuine interest in international business  A proactive work approach and ability to keep multiple client matters moving forward  Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work  Fluent in Finnish and English; knowledge of another Nordic language is an advantage     What We Offer You   You will become part of an experienced and supportive team based at our Finnish headquarters in Pasila, Helsinki, where collaboration and being open are the norm. The role follows a hybrid working model, with three to four days per week in the office. You will have direct access to senior colleagues, real responsibility from the start, and the space to build your skills and career within an international banking environment.   Are you ready for the next step?   If this sounds like the right move for you, please send your CV and cover letter via our recruitment system by  November 11th, 2026 . For questions about the role, please contact the hiring manager Aleksi Soininen at aleksi.soininen@danskebank.com or +358 (0)44 241 8401, on Monday 2nd Nov at 12-14, Wednesday 4th at 12-14, or Friday 6th at 12-14.  We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Director of Private Wealth
description: Lesha Bank is searching for the greatest talent and brightest minds to contribute to the current growth phase at our bank. We are looking for top-tier individuals who are passionate and hungry to add value from day one. Every day at Lesha is different, presenting a new challenge with the opportunity to contribute and grow. We are looking for a Director of Private Wealth.      Role purpose   Drive capital raising and investment distribution for Lesha Bank’s offerings across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities. Acquire and develop relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices and other eligible investors, converting these relationships into funded investments and repeat participation in the Bank’s offerings.      Key responsibilities    Capital raising and business development    Raise capital and attract client allocations into Lesha Bank’s investment offerings, delivering agreed fundraising, net new money and revenue targets.  Develop and execute distribution plans for investment opportunities across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities.  Originate new investor relationships in Qatar and approved regional markets through professional networks, referrals and targeted outreach.  Increase investment participation from existing clients by identifying suitable opportunities aligned with their objectives.  Manage the fundraising pipeline from prospect identification through investor engagement, commitment, subscription and funding.  Maintain accurate forecasts and report on fundraising progress, expected inflows and conversion rates.       Investor relationship management    Manage an assigned portfolio of investors, understanding their investment objectives, risk appetite, liquidity needs and allocation preferences.  Build long-term relationships with investors, family offices and their advisers through regular meetings and proactive communication.  Present investment opportunities clearly, explaining the investment rationale, structure, fees, potential returns, material risks and liquidity or exit considerations.  Coordinate investor presentations and due diligence discussions with the Bank’s investment specialists.  Maintain engagement after investment, coordinating timely updates on performance, distributions and material developments. Work with investment teams to communicate investment propositions accurately and respond to investor enquiries.  Provide feedback on investor demand, allocation preferences and reasons for declining opportunities to inform product development and distribution strategy.  Coordinate with Operations, Legal, Compliance and other relevant teams to ensure timely onboarding, documentation, subscriptions and funding.

title: Kundcenterchef
description: Vi vill vara branschens mest omtyckta arbetsgivare. Inte störst – men bäst när det gäller. Därför investerar vi i våra medarbetare och satsar hållbart för framtiden. Hos oss får du korta beslutsvägar och ett team som samarbetar för att ge bygg- och entreprenadföretag rätt maskin på rätt plats – varje dag.    Nu söker vi en    Kundcenterchef till Umeå    som vill leda och utveckla verksamheten med både affärsfokus och starkt ledarskap.    Ditt uppdrag som Kundcenterchef   Som kundcenterchef hos Arento i Umeå har du ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten – med fokus på lönsamhet, tillväxt och kundnöjdhet. Du leder det dagliga arbetet i kundcentret och säkerställer struktur, effektivitet och hög servicenivå.  Du driver verksamheten både operativt och strategiskt, och arbetar nära både kunder och medarbetare för att skapa bästa möjliga resultat.  En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla affären på den lokala marknaden genom att bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter.    Driva daglig styrning genom morgonmöten samt följa upp verksamheten via månatliga APT  Säkerställa hög servicenivå och att kundens behov alltid står i fokus  Arbeta aktivt med budget, resultat och uppföljning av relevanta nyckeltal  Bevaka och bearbeta den lokala marknaden genom kundbesök  Leda, utveckla och inspirera teamet för att nå gemensamma mål  Driva kundcentrets tillväxt och bredda kundbasen     Vem är du?    Vi söker dig som är en trygg och engagerad ledare med stark affärsförståelse. Du drivs av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet, och har förmågan att skapa struktur samtidigt som du är flexibel och lösningsorienterad.  Du har lätt för att bygga relationer och trivs i en roll där du kombinerar ledarskap med kundkontakt.  Vi ser att du har:    Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team  God affärsförståelse samt erfarenhet av budget- och resultatansvar  Erfarenhet av B2B-affärer och kundbearbetning  Förmåga att skapa och upprätthålla långsiktiga kundrelationer  Intresse för och gärna kunskap om maskiner, fordon eller utrustning inom anläggning  God datorvana (Office-paketet)  Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift  B-körkort     Vi erbjuder dig   Hos oss blir du snabbt en i gänget. Inom Arento delar vi med oss av kunskap och drar nytta av varandras styrkor. Det ger dig unika utvecklingsmöjligheter och öppnar för spännande utmaningar i ett företag i snabb förändring. Med tydliga prestationsmål och utmanande arbetsuppgifter får du utrymme att vässa din spetskompetens och göra skillnad. Och det är lika lätt att få ansvar som att ge – oavsett om du vill göra en ledarskapsresa eller bli specialist. Karriärvägarna är många. Vi uppskattar när du är innovativ. Tillsammans tar vi nästa steg genom att lyssna på kunderna och utveckla hållbara lösningar. Det finns med andra ord många fördelar att dela väg med oss.   Ansök idag!   Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär och leda vårt kundcenter i Umeå? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!  Vi arbetar me

title: IAM Success Manager
description: Are you ready to shape the future of Identity & Access Management?  Identity & Access Management (IAM) is becoming increasingly important as organizations evolve, digitalize, and strengthen their security posture. At If, we are developing modern IAM capabilities that support our employees, partners, and customers while enabling secure and efficient business operations.  We are looking for an IAM Success Manager to join our IAM organization and help drive adoption, engagement, and continuous improvement across our IAM services and products. title: IAM Success Manager
description: Are you ready to shape the future of Identity & Access Management?  Identity & Access Management (IAM) is becoming increasingly important as organizations evolve, digitalize, and strengthen their security posture. At If, we are developing modern IAM capabilities that support our employees, partners, and customers while enabling secure and efficient business operations.  We are looking for an IAM Success Manager to join our IAM organization and help drive adoption, engagement, and continuous improvement across our IAM services and products.  This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of people, processes, technology, and communication. You do not need to be a deep IAM expert from day one, more important is your ability to collaborate with different stakeholders, understand user needs, drive improvements, and help others succeed.   About The Role   As an IAM Success Manager, you will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, product managers, architects, and end users across the organization.  The role combines elements of product management, service management, stakeholder engagement, communication, and change enablement. You will contribute to ensuring that IAM services deliver value, are understood by their users, and continue to evolve based on business needs and feedback.  You will help connect business and technology perspectives, support adoption of IAM capabilities, contribute to communication and awareness activities, and participate in shaping the future direction of identity-related services for human and non-human identities.   We Offer     Benefits   In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:    An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome   Career and development opportunities in the largest insurance company in the Nordics   Social activities and a highly skilled professional environment   Possibility of hybrid workplace   Health-promoting workplace with wellness allowance and sports activities   Great insurance benefits      About The Team   You’ll join Digital Sales and Customer Experience, within Business Area Private, focusing on digital enablers for transformation. Our team lives by If’s core values - collaborating across business and IT to deliver the IAM services our business needs. We believe in creativity, courage, and smart investments to meet future customer demands.   Who Are You?    You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by helping people and organizations succeed. You are comfortable working across different teams and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. title: IT Support Lead (Service Delivery)
description: Du willst ein Supportteam führen, das Kunden verlässlich und planbar betreut? Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen in der richtigen Priorität bei der richtigen Person landet, dass Termine halten und Kunden wissen, woran sie sind? Dann passt diese Rolle zu dir.  Für einen lokalen IT Service Provider in der Region Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als  IT Support Lead (Service Delivery) .  Unser Kunde verbindet IT Solutions, Webentwicklung und Digital Signage. Er betreut regional verankerte KMU, Gemeinden und Schulen: von Microsoft 365, Security, Netzwerk und VoIP bis zu Server und Cloud Infrastruktur. Das Team arbeitet praxisnah, kollegial und kundennah, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Die technische Leitung mit Architektur, Standards und Sicherheit liegt bei dir und dem Engineering Lead im Team. Du verantwortest zusätzlich den Betrieb: Planung, Steuerung und Qualität des Supports.      Deine Aufgaben    Du führst das Supportteam fachlich und organisatorisch und entwickelst es weiter.  Du steuerst den täglichen Betrieb: Eingang, Triage, Prioritäten und Zuteilung der Tickets.  Du planst Einsätze, Termine und Kapazitäten für Support und Kundenprojekte.  Du stellst sicher, dass die vereinbarten Reaktionszeiten eingehalten werden, und führst das Team mit wenigen klaren Kennzahlen.  Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Kunden bei Störungen und Eskalationen und informierst proaktiv.  Du planst und koordinierst Kundenprojekte wie Migrationen, Übernahmen oder Telefonie, zusammen mit dem Engineering Lead.  Du arbeitest selbst im Support mit, vor allem in der ersten und zweiten Stufe.  Du entwickelst Prozesse, Checklisten und Dokumentation weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.  Du bringst die Anforderungen aus dem Betrieb in die Weiterentwicklung des eigenen Supportportals ein.       Dein Profil    Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ, HF oder vergleichbare Erfahrung.  Mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT Support oder bei einem Managed Service Provider, idealerweise mit Verantwortung für Planung, Dispatch oder ein Team.  Du denkst in Prioritäten, Terminen und Kundennutzen und behältst auch unter Druck den Überblick.  Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, RMM und Monitoring. Kenntnisse im Servicemanagement, zum Beispiel ITIL, sind ein Plus.  Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, Windows Clients und Server, dazu Grundlagen in Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und VoIP.  Klare und freundliche Kommunikation mit Kunden und im Team, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ist ein Plus.  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest strukturiert und führst gerne.       Das erwartet dich    Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Team, das wachsen will.  Ein Engineering Lead an deiner Seite für Technik und Architektur, damit du dich auf Betrieb, Kunden und Team konzentrieren kannst.  Ein eigenes Supportportal, das mit deinen Anforderungen weiterentwickelt wird.  Moderne Technologien und abwechslungsreiche Kundenumge

title: Team Lead, Operations Support
description: At IAG, we’re ready for you. We're the largest general insurance group in Australia and New Zealand. Our family of brands turns the IAG purpose of making your world a safer place into action by helping everyday Aussies and New Zealanders, supporting their ambitions and making insurance accessible.    Lead the team that keeps critical technology services running smoothly.   Play a key role in helping technology services stay reliable, resilient and responsive. As  Team Lead, Operations Support , you'll lead a team responsible for supporting business-critical platforms across Australia and New Zealand within a 24/7 operational support environment, ensuring production issues are managed effectively and customers and colleagues can rely on the services they use every day.  You'll bring people, technology and operational priorities together, creating a strong support capability while helping teams navigate an exciting period of technology transformation. Working closely with stakeholders, delivery teams and external partners, you'll drive service excellence while building a high-performing, future-ready team.   This is a permanent full-time role based in Tāmaki Makaurau (Auckland), Ōtautahi (Christchurch) or Te Whanganui-a-Tara (Wellington). Lead a 24/7 operational support capability, overseeing operational monitoring, triage, incident response and service restoration activities to maintain reliable platform performance.   Coordinate production support, release activities and service requests across multiple technology environments.   Use operational insights and service data to identify trends and deliver continuous improvement initiatives.   Partner with engineering, testing, delivery and business teams to resolve issues and improve service outcomes.   Manage external partners and suppliers to ensure service expectations and performance standards are achieved.   Provide clear reporting on service health, risks, capacity and improvement opportunities to support decision making.     Ōu Pūkenga me ōu Wheako | What You'll Bring      Experience leading technology operations, production support or application support teams.   Strong people leadership skills with a focus on coaching, development and team engagement.   Ability to manage incidents, competing priorities and operational demands within a 24/7 support environment.   Experience using operational data and service insights to drive continuous improvement.   Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills with the ability to influence outcomes.   Confidence working through ambiguity and supporting teams during periods of change.   An understanding of technology transformation, platform modernisation or large-scale operational environments. title: Project Delivery Lead
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare!   At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.  We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!   About The Role   As Project Delivery Lead, you will help Swedish municipalities successfully implement and adopt Tandem across their healthcare and social care services. You will lead complex deployments, build trusted relationships with municipal stakeholders, and drive the change management needed for our technology to deliver meaningful improvements to everyday workflows.  Alongside owning a portfolio of key customers, you will provide day-to-day leadership to the Project Delivery team, supporting colleagues, coordinating implementations, and improving how we deliver as we grow. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Medical Operations to ensure successful implementations and long-term customer value.  What you will do    Lead municipal implementations: Own end-to-end implementations, from kickoff and planning through to training, go-live, and ongoing adoption, adapting the approach to each municipality’s organisation, workflows, and needs.   Lead and develop the team: Provide day-to-day people leadership, supporting team members in managing complex projects, resolving customer challenges, and developing their stakeholder management skills. Identify development needs, support performance improvement, and contribute to hiring and onboarding new team members.   Manage key customer relationships: Build trusted relationships with municipal leaders, social services and healthcare managers, social workers, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders. Lead customer reviews, demonstrate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve adoption and expand usage.   Drive adoption and customer value: Help municipalities embed Tandem into their everyday workflows, ensuring social workers and healthcare professionals understand the technology and realise its benefits in reducing documentation burden.   Lead change management: Support municipalities in introducing new ways of working, engaging managers and frontline staff early, identifying champions, addressing concerns, and establishing routines that last beyond go-live. Develop change management practices that can be applied consistently across the Project Delivery team.   Lead day-to-day delivery operations: Coordinate concurrent implementations, support colleagues with complex challenges, manage workloads and escalations, and maintain consistent standards of implementation quality.   Improve delivery process

title: Delivery Manager & Team Lead - Communardo Sweden
description: At Communardo, we believe great consulting is about more than technology. It’s about understanding people, business needs and the challenges behind the request — and making sure the right people are working on the right problem.  We work exclusively with Atlassian, helping customers build a system of work where people, processes, tools — and increasingly AI — work together rather than in silos. Communardo has around 500 experts across Europe, combining strong local customer relationships in the Nordics with deep specialist knowledge across the group.   Your Mission     Staff your engagements with the right consultants and plan ahead across current and upcoming work.  Keep CWR / utilization healthy for your team and your engagements and contribute to healthy utilization across Communardo Sweden.  Be the customer’s direct line for delivery: track status, scope and contracts, spot risks early and handle escalations.  Work closely with the other Team Leads so staffing and consultant development support each other.  Flag sellable capacity to the Country Sales Manager and support Sales with staffing of new opportunities and proposals.      Your Profile     Solid experience from Atlassian consulting or professional services — credible with both customers and consultants on Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Atlassian Cloud.  Experience from resources, delivery or engagement management, with responsibility for staffing, utilization and customer delivery.  Experience as a people leader for consultants.  Comfort with the numbers: CWR / utilization, capacity, forecasting and margin.  The ability to balance many engagements, people and priorities — and to make clear staffing decisions that hold up.  Strong communication skills in Swedish and English and based in or near one of our locations.  Experience from an Atlassian Solution Partner, Cloud migrations, ITSM/ESM or Atlassian AI/Rovo is a plus.      Good Reasons to Join Us   A key role at the center of customers, consultants and Sales — with a real say in how Communardo Sweden delivers.  People leadership combined with hands-on customer responsibility, and a clear leadership career path.  Large customers where Atlassian is business-critical, and some of the most experienced Atlassian consultants in the Nordics.  The chance to shape how we bring AI, including Rovo, into the way we deliver.  Funded Atlassian certifications, hybrid working and competitive salary, pension and benefits.  If you enjoy putting the right people on the right problem — and making sure customers, get real value from Atlassian — we’d like to hear from you. title: Werkstudent Marketing & Social Media
description:
Über uns

Wir sind ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Technische Gebäudeausrüstung (TGA) sowie zukunftsorientierte Gebäude- und Energiesysteme. Als technischer Gesamtplaner entwickeln wir ganzheitliche, wirtschaftliche und nachhaltige Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Projekte im Hochbau und in der technischen Infrastruktur. Dabei decken wir nahezu das gesamte Spektrum der TGA ab und begleiten unsere Kunden über alle Leistungsphasen hinweg – von der ersten Beratung und Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.

Kreativität, Content und Kommunikation

Du hast ein Gespür für gutes Design, interessierst dich für Social Media und hast Lust, kreative Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen? Du möchtest nicht nur Inhalte planen und gestalten, sondern auch selbst vor der Kamera stehen und neue Content-Formate entwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.

The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our labs are where new ideas are turned into working quantum sensing systems — and you are the person who keeps those systems running.

If you enjoy hands-on technical work, have an eye for detail, and are curious about how things work, we will teach you everything you need to know about our systems. title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

title: Senior ML Engineer (Agentic Search)

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform for AI systems, the emerging web access layer for AI. Our focus is agentic search, where AI systems plan, retrieve and refine rather than just return results.

You will develop and deploy machine learning models that power retrieval, ranking, and indexing at scale, helping AI systems access fresh, reliable information in real time.

This is a high-impact role working on a production system used 24x7, operating at the scale of web search.

Your responsibilities:

  • Train and deploy ML models for retrieval, reranking, and search relevance, such as embedding models and cross-encoders, in production

  • Develop models supporting crawling, data selection, and content understanding

  • Build and maintain the data, training and evaluation pipelines behind our models: training-data generation, evaluation sets and retraining

  • Contribute to and improve our ML platform: training and orchestration workflows (Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, experiment tracking, model lifecycle) and inference optimisation for low-latency serving

  • Work closely with engineering to integrate and deploy ML models in production services, balancing latency, quality and cost

  • Apply the latest architectural advances and training procedures for retrieval and LLM-integrated systems

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or applied machine learning

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of Go or C++

  • Proven experience deploying ML models in production systems

  • Solid understanding of machine learning and modern deep learning, including transformers and embeddings

  • Experience building data or ML pipelines and working with workflow orchestration

  • Ability to define meaningful model metrics and evaluate models rigorously

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

  • Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.
  • Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.
  • Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.
  • Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.
  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.
  • Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.
  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. title: Lead Growth Analyst
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are.

title: (766) Program Analyst
description:

Arlo Solutions is supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Integrity and Compliance (OIC) in standing up and running the VHA Fraud Rapid Response Center ("VA War Room"). title: Engineering Manager
description:
Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're always looking for thoughtful, driven Engineering Managers to add to our org. Some of our teams are building customer-facing product and workflows; others keep our distributed systems reliable, observable, and ready to scale. Whichever kind of problem energizes you, if you lead people well, hold a high technical bar, and drive work to completion without waiting to be handed a plan, we want to hear from you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies—from scrappy startups to global brands—use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data—what people do or don't do inside a web or mobile app. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What we value

Ownership. You set direction and see initiatives through. You create clarity when things are murky and set the path forward rather than waiting for one to be defined, and you're motivated by impact—not just intention. You hold yourself and your team accountable to shipping, not just staying busy.

Leaders who can do both. You operate at the strategic level and stay close to the technical work. You can align stakeholders on a plan and earn your engineers' respect in the same day—you don't choose between vision and execution, you hold both.

A drive to execute through resistance. Competing priorities, skeptical stakeholders, tired teams—you've moved work forward anyway. You name the resistance, make the call, and own the milestones and the misses.

An AI-first mindset. AI is central to how you build and how you lead your team to build. You have a real, concrete point of view on AI-native development, you use agentic tooling yourself, and you bring it into how your squad operates.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done." You bring rigor and pragmatism. Best practices matter—but never more than forward motion. You know when to build, when to buy, and when to wait—and you're comfortable making the call with incomplete information, then adjusting as you learn.

What you'll do

  • Care deeply about our customers and their outcomes
  • Lead your squad to deliver real customer value by owning projects end to end—from planning through delivery, quality, and follow-through

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

title: Head of security
description:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own a risk-based security strategy for a financial platform; prioritize investment by real threat and business impact, and report on posture to executive leadership and the board

  • Incident Response: Own detection, response, and recovery for security incidents; maintain runbooks, lead incidents and post-incident reviews, coordinate with forensics, legal, and communications, and turn every incident into lasting improvements

  • Application Security: Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST/dependency scanning, and secure coding standards that engineers actually adopt

title: Senior Product Manager - Commerce
description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come Do the Best Work of Your Life at Boulevard

Every transaction that flows through Boulevard is a moment of truth — for the client who just received a service, and for the business trying to run a great operation. Commerce isn't just a feature layer; it's the transactional layer that thousands of businesses rely on to deliver exceptional client service, transact, and grow revenue. When the experience is right, it's seamless. When it's not, friction ripples from the front desk all the way into the business' books.

As Boulevard expands upmarket, supports complex franchise brands, and grows internationally, the commerce experience has to scale with it — more flexible, more reliable, and more intuitive for the operators and clients who depend on it every day. As Senior PM for Commerce Experience, you'll partner closely with a dedicated engineering and design team, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate underlying capabilities into experiences that feel obvious, trustworthy, and complete for a business and their clients. You'll bring rigor to how we measure and improve those experiences over time, using data and customer insight to continuously close the gap between where things are and where they need to be.

What You'll Bring

-5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a B2B or SaaS environment and a track record of owning consumer-facing flows end-to-e

  • Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness and support managers in the consistent application of HR policies and procedures.

  • Manage and administer employee leaves of absence across the US and Canada, including FMLA, state and provincial leave programs, disability-related absences, and other applicable leaves.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers regarding leave eligibility, documentation requirements, leave status, and return-to-work processes.
  • Coordinate workplace accommodation and return-to-work arrangements in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

title: Lead Supply Chain Coördinator
description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen, waarbij we onze kracht van de kortste keten van boer tot bord inzetten op een manier waar je trots op kunt zijn. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen.

Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je teamleden, voert de gesprekken die daarbij horen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat je van hem of haar verwacht.

title: Junior Business Controller
description:
Steer our numbers, fuel our growth – so our team can focus on saving birds and stopping drones.

As our Jr. Business Controller, you bring data to life and turn financial insights into smart operational decisions. You work closely with your team and colleagues across the business to build accurate forecasts, spot trends, and guide our strategic goals. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Controlling, your sharp financial eye gives our management crew the clarity they need to keep Robin Radar moving forward.

What you'll do

Financial forecasting and analysis: Collate, analyze, and interpret financial data using preset tools and methods. Drive our budget forecasting and closing processes to keep our growth plans on track.

Reporting and dashboarding: Deliver clear management analytics, periodic reports, and visual dashboards. Give leaders across the organization the visibility they need for confident operational oversight.

Variance and trend analysis: Run variance analysis to track operational performance. Identify trend deviations early and translate those shifts into actionable steering advice for key stakeholders.

Financial policies and internal controls: Advise on financial guidelines and help optimize internal control procedures. Resolve routine queries, handle continuous practice improvements, and keep standards consistently high.

Compliance and risk oversight: Review financial data periodically to verify completeness and accuracy. Ensure full alignment with regulatory codes and escalate non-compliance risks before they impact the business.

title: Stage HSE / Veiligheid
description:
Hoe kun jij bijdragen?

Wil jij tijdens je stage direct bijdragen aan een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving binnen een technische productieorganisatie? Bij NX Filtration krijg je de kans om onze huidige Risico-Inventarisatie & Evaluatie (RI&E) kritisch onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken in hoeverre deze nog aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk.

Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak.

Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie.

Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor.

De centrale vraag tijdens jouw stage is:

“In hoeverre sluit de huidige RI&E van NX Filtration aan op de actuele risico's binnen de organisatie en welke verbetermaatregelen hebben de hoogste prioriteit?”

Wie zijn wij

NX Filtration produceert membraanfilters die wereldwijd worden gebruikt om de kleinste vervuilingen uit water te filteren. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Dit heeft geresulteerd in nieuwe en eenvoudige processen voor de behandeling van water, het hergebruik van afvalwater en de productie van drinkwater. title: Projectontwikkelaar woningbouw
description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige woningbouwprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke woningbouwontwikkelingen en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

 

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

title: Senior Implementatiemanager Sociaal Domein    |   Gemeente Den Haag

Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen.

Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking.

description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine.
