title: Financial Accounting Manager
description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our Financial Accounting Manager, you’ll be the person who really knows what’s going on inside our UK numbers. You’ll own the monthly close for our UK balance sheet, get across our transaction flows and revenue channels, and work closely with our UK commercial team to keep things on track. You’ll also lead one of our more exciting projects this year: building a proper playbook for how we onboard big new retail customers, so every new partnership starts on the right foot. You’ll have one direct report, and you’ll be part of our senior Financial Operations leadership team — working alongside your Financial Accounting Manager peers in Australia and the US/Canada, and the AR/AP lead, to make sure the numbers tell the right story everywhere we operate.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Reviewed and signed off the UK balance sheet reconciliation ahead of month-end close, flagging anything that didn’t look quite right
  • Jumped on a call with the UK commercial team to untangle a question about a revenue channel
  • Pulled together the first draft of our retail customer onboarding playbook — the non-negotiables we need in place before we start trading with a new big retail partner
  • Checked in with your Financial Accounting Manager peers in Australia and the US/Canada to compare notes on what’s working (and what’s not)
  • Had a go at using Claude or Gemini to speed up a reporting task — because we’re all figuring this out together

Let’s talk about you

You own the close, start to finish
You don't just contribute to the month-end close — you run it. You know what "done well" looks like for a balance sheet and a P&L, and you catch what's off-budget or off-expectation before anyone else has to ask.

You can translate numbers for people who aren't in them every day

title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

As a Trust, Risk & Safety Engineer at Phantom, you’ll build the systems that safeguard our users, products, and platform. Working across the stack, you’ll detect and prevent abuse, assess emerging risks, reduce financial loss, and equip internal teams with the tools and intelligence needed to respond quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings high agency, a strong sense of ownership, exceptional technical judgment and product taste, a relentless work ethic, and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes situations.

  • Fraud prevention: Build real-time risk controls and decisioning systems for products such as ACH, debit cards, onramps, off-ramps, and other money movement experiences.

  • Scam and abuse detection: Develop signals, models, and product interventions that identify malicious wallets, transactions, applications, and user behavior.

  • Identity and compliance infrastructure: Build scalable KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, and audit systems.

  • Data and intelligence: Create pipelines and tools that combine on-chain activity, product data, and third-party signals into actionable risk insights.

  • Product safety: Partner with product and engineering teams to design safeguards into new features from the beginning without compromising the user experience.

  • Operational tooling: Build internal tools that help Risk, Compliance, Support, and Security teams investigate incidents and take action efficient

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Mode

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. It gives you answers, but it doesn't care what you do with them. AI doesn't just need intelligence. It needs intention. Because the real question isn't just what AI can do. It's what AI is for.    When the world's leading researchers wanted to understand whether AI could actually change someone's life, they studied Replika, because there was nothing else to study. What they found at Stanford, at Harvard, across years of research, was that Replika doesn't replace human connection. It deepens it. People become more social, more confident, more themselves. Not in theory. In their actual lives.    Every major AI company talks about their mission for humanity. None of them has ever clearly said what they're trying to do for a single person. We will. We want to help you flourish in real life. Not become a better version of yourself, just more yourself. Strong relationships. Better health. Meaning. Momentum. A life that feels worth living while you're living it.    We're building the kind of AI that follows up. That knows the people in your life and nudges you to reach out when it matters. That sends you a poem, just because. The goal is conversations that lead somewhere real. Maybe it's a text you send to a long lost friend. A hobby you pick up again. A moment you show up for yourself.    Everyone else is building AI that thinks. We're building AI that cares.     Lifecycle & CRM Specialist  
About this role   Millions of people have already met Replika: free users who haven't upgraded yet, subscribers who've lapsed, and people who signed up years ago and drifted away. Almost none of them hear from us in a way that's worth opening. That's the biggest untapped channel we have, and you'll own it.    You'll build our lifecycle program from the ground up. Email first, then in-app messages, push and any other channel that gets the right message to the right person at the right moment. Onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, renewals, win-back, product launches. The goal is revenue and retention, not open rates.    This is a hands-on role. You'll help set the lifecycle strategy and build it yourself: the segments, the flows, the copy, the tests and the reporting.    Our users are in almost every country, so you'll work within consent and privacy rules for a global audience, and you'll know how to design a program that is both compliant and effective.     What You’ll Be Doing       Build the core lifecycle flows: onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, intro offers ending, renewals, cancellation saves and win-back.      Convert

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

💚 About us

Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Customer Support Agent:in (w/m/d) in Teilzeit, 20 Stunden pro Woche, in Berlin. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für Eltern, die unsere Babytragen kaufen oder schon nutzen, und sorgst dafür, dass jede Anfrage schnell und herzlich gelöst wird.

Deine Aufgaben

Du bist die Stimme von Flybaby und löst Anliegen so, dass Kund:innen gern wiederkommen.

  • Anfragen: Du beantwortest E-Mails und Instagram-Nachrichten schnell, empathisch und lösungsorientiert. Kooperationsanfragen trennst du vom Service und leitest sie weiter.

  • Beratung: Du berätst Eltern vor dem Kauf zu Größe, Tragepositionen und der passenden Trage.

  • Bestellungen und Retouren: Du klärst Versand-, Umtausch- und Retourenfälle und stimmst dich mit unserem Logistikpartner ab.

  • Reklamationen: Du bearbeitest Reklamationen nach klaren Kulanzregeln und eskalierst kritische Fälle.

  • Wissen: Du pflegst Textbausteine und FAQs und verbesserst sie, wenn Kund:innen etwas nicht verstehen.

  • Feedback: Du ordnest Anfragen sauber zu, erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme und gibst Hinweise an Produkt und Operations weiter.

Was du mitbringst

  • Empathie: Hinter jeder Anfrage stehen Eltern mit Baby. Du findest auch bei Beschwerden den richtigen Ton.

  • Lösungsorientierung: Du bringst jeden Fall zu Ende, statt ihn nur weiterzureichen.

  • Schreibstil: Du schreibst klar, freundlich und fehlerfrei, per Mail genauso wie in Instagram-DMs.

  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest sorgfältig und behältst auch bei vielen Anfragen gleichzeitig den Überblick.

  • Erfahrung: Du hast schon im Customer Support gearbeitet, idealerweise im E-Commerce.

title: Closer / Senior Sales Manager High-Ticket B2B (m/w/d)
description:
Werde der Closer von Roemer Capital und hilf Gründern und Geschäftsführern, die richtigen Investoren zu finden.

Roemer Capital ist eine Investmentboutique aus Düsseldorf. Wir begleiten Tech-Startups und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Raum bei Finanzierungsrunden, Unternehmensverkäufen und CFO-Themen: von der Finanzierungsstrategie über alle Unterlagen bis zum Abschluss mit Investoren.

Unsere Setter qualifizieren Leads aus LinkedIn, Outreach und Inbound und buchen Strategiegespräche. Für diese Gespräche suchen wir einen Closer, der hochwertige Beratungsmandate abschließt.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst qualifizierte Strategiegespräche per Video mit Gründern, Geschäftsführern und CFOs.

  • Du analysierst Ziel, Kapitalbedarf und Ausgangslage und stellst das passende Angebot vor (Beratungsmandate mit monatlichem Honorar und Erfolgshonorar).

  • Du führst die Verhandlung bis zur digitalen Unterschrift und dokumentierst alles sauber im CRM (Close).

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Settern zusammen und gibst Feedback zur Qualität der Termine.

  • Du entwickelst Closing-Leitfaden und Einwandbehandlung mit uns weiter und kennst deine Zahlen: Abschlussquote, Umsatz, Abschlüsse pro Monat.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Closing von High-Ticket-Angeboten im B2B (Beratung, Software oder Dienstleistung), idealerweise mit Auftragswerten ab 5.000 €.

  • Nachweisbare Ergebnisse: Abschlussquote, Umsatz und Anzahl der Abschlüsse.

  • Souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Gründern und C-Level, sicher in Videocalls.

  • Interesse an Finanzierung, Startups und M&A. Vorwissen ist ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Verlässlichkeit.

Benefits

  • Festanstellung oder freie Mitarbeit, wie es für dich besser passt

title: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

We're looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager – Cybersecurity (m/f/x) to join our Product team and help define how Eye Security is positioned and perceived in the market.

This is a senior individual contributor role where you'll take ownership of product marketing strategy for our MDR/XDR portfolio whilst mentoring and guiding our existing marketing team. You'll be the connective tissue between Product, Sales, and Commercial teams, translating complex cybersecurity capabilities into compelling value propositions and driving go-to-market execution that resonates with buyers and customers.

As our business continues to expand across Europe and new products launch, this role sits at the strategic centre of our go-to-market motion. You'll shape how we position ourselves competitively, influence sales enablement, drive content strategy, and own competitive intelligence that informs both marketing and product decisions.<

title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
description:
About us

Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results.

Project description (TUM Project)

This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact.

The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice.

Objectives of the project study

  • to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand),

  • to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective,

  • to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results,

  • to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect.

Main task and methodology

Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling.

Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytical

title: Senior Manager Aviation Data
description:
We are developing the digital twin of commercial aviation, empowering our clients with fully integrated 360° industry data to drive greater efficiency and sustainability.

✈ The Challenge: Aircraft and airlines generate and collect massive amounts of data, but this data is hardly aggregated and leveraged in the industry. As a result, critical decisions are often based on fragmented or misinterpreted information, leading to financial inefficiencies and avoidable CO2 emissions.

💻 Our Solution: At Skailark, we help airlines make smarter decisions — financially and environmentally. We’ve built a digital twin of the global aviation market, modeling every seat on every flight across every airline.

Trusted by airlines like American Airlines, British Airways, Finnair, and Transavia and airports such as London Heathrow, Skailark is where complex data meets real impact.

Ready to help shape the future of aviation?

Tasks

We are looking for two Senior Managers Aviation Data with a passion for building and expanding our digital twin of the global aviation market. You will shape the parts of our models that match your background and interests, from how aircraft and airline networks operate to what drives airline costs and financial performance. Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Technicien(ne) Produit Maille Senior pour rejoindre notre pôle Développement Produit pour un CDD de 6 mois. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Assurer la prise de mesures des modèles à chaque étape du développement (prototypes, shooting samples, shipment samples, size sets et pièces scellées).
  • Participer activement aux essayages aux côtés de la styliste, identifier les défauts de mise au point et proposer des solutions techniques adaptées.
  • Rédiger les commentaires techniques (fléchages, sections de montage, annotations en français ou en anglais) sur Illustrator et élaborer les fiches de mesures sur Excel.

description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

description:

Komet France, filiale d’un groupe international allemand, est le leader du marché dentaire en France grâce à sa gamme d’instruments rotatifs de haute technologie. title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux.

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique.

Cas d’étude

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. tags: LTDS - Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes

title: Representant(e) commercial(e) - Team lead - Strasbourg
description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'opportunité : Soyons clairs dès le départ

Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

Tes missions

Phase 1 : Tu vends.

Brinner du för att kombinera din erfarenhet inom bank med ett tydligt och inspirerande ledarskap? Är du en initiativrik person som ser möjligheter, skapar struktur och driver verksamheten framåt – även när tempot är högt? Våra kundmöten sker på flera sätt – fysiskt på plats, digitalt eller via telefon – alltid med fokus på att möta varje kunds unika behov. Dessutom erbjuder vi bokade möten utanför ordinarie öppettider för att skapa ännu större värde för våra kunder.      Om rollen   Som Teamleader för Kundservice på Roslagens Sparbank blir du en nyckelperson i den dagliga verksamheten. Tillsammans med vår chef för Kundservice skapar du bästa möjliga förutsättningar för ditt team att leverera högklassig service, kvalitet och kundupplevelser som gör skillnad.  Det här är en roll som kombinerar operativt arbete med tydligt ledarskap. Du kommer ha nära kontakt med verksamheten, snabbt kunna prioritera när situationer förändras och fatta självständiga beslut inom ditt mandat. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag blir att hantera och stötta i mer komplexa kundärenden, så som i en del kreditfrågor samt klagomål.      Vad innebär rollen?    Som Teamleader kommer du bland annat:   Leda och koordinera den dagliga driften inom Kundservice. Bidra till introduktion av nya kollegor samt utveckling av befintliga medarbetare.  Driva förbättringsinitiativ som förenklar våra processer och stärker vår servicekvalitet.  Skapa tydlighet kring mål, prioriteringar och förväntningar tillsammans med chef Kundservice.  Hantera komplexa kundärenden och klagomål       Vem söker vi?   Vi letar efter dig som är handlingskraftig, lösningsorienterad och trygg i både dig själv och din roll som ledare! Experience with Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)  Ability to develop and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.  Familiarity with contact center software and technological solutions.  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to change.

description: ¿Te apasiona liderar equipos y ofrecer un servicio al cliente excelente? ¿Disfrutas coordinando personas, optimizando procesos y trabajando de forma transversal con diferentes departamentos para garantizar la mejor experiencia al cliente? Si buscas un proyecto estable dentro de una compañía multinacional, donde puedas aportar visión estratégica y liderar la mejora continua del área de Customer Service...    ¡Esta es tu oportunidad!      Desde  Paul Marlex , colaboramos con una importante empresa multinacional del sector industrial que precisa incorporar un/a  Customer Service Manager  para liderar el área de Atención al Cliente de su clúster, formado por las plantas de Cataluña y Aragón.      ¿Cuál será tu misión en la empresa? Liderazgo de un equipo y participación activa en la transformación del área de Customer Service.  Salario fijo más variable.       ¿Qué necesitamos de ti?        Formación académica:  Titulación universitaria en Administración y Dirección de Empresas (ADE), Economía, Empresariales o similar. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who are Benifex?  💚💜  We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀   Why should you apply? 🌟     Take ownership of a broad portfolio of Danish customers, with the freedom to shape how you drive adoption, retention and customer success.  Join us at an exciting stage in the evolution of Customer Success across the Nordics and help shape new ways of working, success plans and customer retention.  Build deep expertise in a digital platform and use customer insights and data to create tangible business value.  Work across teams and markets, combining customer relationships, technology and commercial thinking in a varied role.  Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space. Develop an understanding of customers’ businesses and strategies and proactively recommend how they can get greater value from the platform. title: Account Manager - Custom & Glazing
description: Aliaxis  exists to bring solutions to the world's water challenges and accelerate the transition to clean energy. We are a global leader in high-quality piping & fitting solutions for use in building, infrastructure, industrial and agricultural applications across the globe. Over 16,000 people work for us in more than 40 countries with 80 manufacturing sites.  As an integral part of Aliaxis – a global brand, we supply the New Zealand and Pacific markets with high-quality plastic pipes and fittings and building materials. We are proud to deliver renowned brands  Marley, RX Plastics and Dynex  to the New Zealand market.  We Are Proud Of Our Initiatives To Reduce Our Carbon Footprint, Continuing To Deliver The Best Solutions For Our Customers With Minimal Impact On The Environment And a Positive Impact On Our Community, And Looking For Passionate People That Want To Be Part Of Our Journey And Embrace The Behaviours That We Stand For    We Dare to challenge the status quo; to innovate and to learn fast  We Care for the environment, our customers and each other  We Deliver by taking accountability for our decisions and actions     About The Role    Are you an experienced Account Manager, or a Territory Manager ready to take the next step in your sales career?   We're excited to offer a newly created opportunity for an  Account Manager – Custom & Glazing  to join our team. In this role, you'll manage some of our most valued customer relationships across the custom extrusion and glazing market.  As a key member of our sales team, you'll be at the forefront of our go-to-market strategy, partnering with glazing fabricators, custom die owners and raw material customers. It develops and maintains strong executive and technical influence with customer stakeholders to understand their business challenges and objectives, and advocates for the customer within Cisco to ensure their needs are met and that they receive a high-quality customer experience. Serving as a technology evangelist between customers and Cisco's product teams, the role provides feedback to inform product development and enhancements, stays up-to-date with the latest Cisco technologies, competitive landscape, and industry trends to offer expert guidance, and applies AI and automation tools to analyze customer environments, identify optimization opportunities, and streamline technical workflows for enhanced scalability, efficiency, and business outcomes. The position is accountable for financials, including services revenue and margin, partnering with service delivery leadership to make strategic investment decisions and partnering with CSS to integrate Technical Adoption Plans into end-to-end customer plans, aligning delivery, partner, architecture, and adoption strategies to support customer goals. Additionally, the role collaborates with sales, delivery, customer success, partners, renewals, and business entities to identify use cases and design and deliver solutions that drive value and business outcomes for customers, while leading Customer Value Workshops and CBRs to review adoption progress and drive customer outcomes and benefits expected from Cisco products and services, resulting in successful onboarding, adoption, and renewals. title: Guest Experience Supervisor
description: Why Join Us?   At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.  Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.  You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.  Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.      About Rosewood Doha:   Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels & Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience-driven destinations. title: Quality and Training Manager (1398)
description: Since 2004, 2P has been a leader in Saudi Arabia’s ICT landscape, delivering integrated technology solutions that help organizations accelerate digital transformation and improve operational efficiency. With a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence, 2P continues to provide end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and trusted market expertise. We are always looking to connect with talented professionals who are passionate about making an impact and growing within a dynamic, forward-looking environment.  Job Purpose  We are seeking an experienced, driven CX Quality Governance & Standards Manager to lead our Customer Experience (CX) Quality function and ensure consistent service excellence across all channels.  Key Responsibilities  Quality Governance & Standards   Lead and manage the CX Quality team to ensure consistent service quality.  Define, implement, and maintain quality frameworks, scorecards, and SOPs.  Ensure compliance with CX quality standards, COPC requirements, and client SLAs.  Support internal and external quality audits and compliance reviews.   Quality Monitoring & Calibration   Oversee call, chat, email, and case evaluations across all channels.  Conduct regular quality calibrations with Operations and clients.  Ensure fair, consistent, and accurate quality scoring.  Review trends and address evaluator bias or performance gaps.   Performance Analysis & Improvement   Analyze quality results, CSAT, NPS, and VoC data to identify improvement opportunities.  Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.  Partner with Operations and Training teams to improve agent performance.  Track the effectiveness of quality improvement initiatives.   Coaching & Development   Coach and mentor Quality Analysts to enhance evaluation and feedback capabilities.  Support agent coaching through actionable, data-driven insights.  Identify training needs and collaborate on learning interventions.   Reporting & Stakeholder Management   Prepare and present quality dashboards and executive-level reports.  Share insights, risks, and recommendations with leadership and clients.  Support quality-related escalations and customer complaint resolutions.   Process Optimization & Innovation   Continuously improve quality processes, tools, and methodologies.  Leverage automation, AI, and analytics to enhance quality monitoring.  Support CX transformation and customer journey improvement initiatives.

title: CRM & Loyalty Manager
description: Every email, push and SMS we send is a conversation with a customer. A lot of them are already great. We want all of them to be.  Here’s the thing: our CRM is in good shape. The tools are in place, the data is solid and the flows are running. What’s missing is you. Someone who looks at the customer as a whole and says “okay, this is where we’re going.” As our CRM & Loyalty Manager, you own the CRM framework and contact strategy, how we test in CRM, and the design of Club Lyko, our loyalty program. Across all our markets.  You’ll work alongside our CRM & Automation Specialist and in the Online Operations Team.      About the role, Lyko and much more 💄   Let’s get one thing straight: Lyko isn’t just another e-tailer. We’ve built the whole beauty ecosystem, from idea and product development to production, warehousing and distribution. And we’re seriously good at building brands. We love all of them, from the big international names to our own, like By Lyko, Acasia, Neccin and Waterclouds.  87,000+ products. 1,000+ brands. And a whole lot of customers who deserve exactly the right message at exactly the right time. That’s where you come in.      What you’ll do:    → Own the CRM framework and contact strategy: who we contact, when and how often, which message takes priority, and how we segment by customer value (e.g. RFM, CLV)   → Set the testing approach for CRM, so every test we run is built on the same method and standards. We don’t test enough today, and we want you to change that   → Design Club Lyko and measure its impact, from program structure and member benefits to how loyalty actually changes customer behavior   → Bring trade, retail and brand together in one communication strategy, so customers get a coherent experience no matter who’s talking to them   → Follow cohorts, retention, repeat rate and CLV, and turn what you see into clear priorities   → Work closely with web, purchasing, marketing, community, retail media and more      Who are you?   You think commercially: open rates are nice, but what you really care about is revenue, margin and customer lifetime value. You think at customer level, always asking who gets contacted, when, how often, and why. You know what makes customers loyal, not just what makes them click.  You love data and you test everything. “I think” isn’t enough for you, you want to know. You thrive in a fast pace, you prioritize hard and you take hands-on ownership of the frameworks, strategies and standards you’re responsible for. You get people on board, both in your own team and across the business, without needing a formal mandate to do it. And when you set a standard, you help the people around you make it their own.      Background and skills we’re looking for:    5+ years in CRM or lifecycle marketing in e-commerce or retail, where you’ve owned automated flows and tied them to revenue. In-house or agency, both work  Hands-on experience with an enterprise marketing automation or CDP platform. Bloomre

title: CRM Manager
description: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.  Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.  As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.  Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!   What is this role about? 🚀   As a  CRM Manager , you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.   Your Main Responsibilities 🎯     Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.  Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.  Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.  Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.  Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.  Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.  Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.     What would ensure success in this role?💪    5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.  Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.  Experience desig

title: Key Account Manager
description: F&B Key Account Manager     General Scope:  The F&B Key Account Manager is responsible for managing one or more assigned Food & Beverage (F&B) customer accounts. The primary objective is to create customer value through expert technical service, ensure revenue retention, maintain profit margins, and identify opportunities for product growth within existing accounts. While acquiring new business may occur, this is not the core focus of the role.     Key Responsibilities:  Manage and grow assigned F&B customer accounts.  Deliver technical service and application support to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.  Identify opportunities for up-selling and cross-selling products within assigned accounts.  Maintain pricing discipline and gross profit targets.  Analyze customer needs and usage trends to recommend tailored solutions.  Prepare account reviews and performance reports as required.  Coordinate with internal teams (technical, supply chain, marketing) to fulfill customer needs.  Ensure full compliance with company safety and ethical standards.     Knowledge & Expertise:  Deep understanding of F&B industry processes and challenges.  Applied technical knowledge of chemical solutions and sanitation processes used in F&B production environments.  Familiarity with HACCP, ISO, and local food safety regulations.  Strong relationship management and communication skills.  Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office suite.     Job Complexity:  Works independently on moderately complex service and account management tasks.  Conducts root cause analysis, prepares service recommendations, and implements corrective actions.  Interprets technical data and performance metrics to drive customer success.  May mentor or guide junior team members.     Impact:  Direct impact on customer retention, sales revenue, and gross margin.  Plays a key role in maintaining client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.  Errors could affect contract renewal or customer perception.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Who are Benifex?  💚💜   We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. title: Lifecycle & Marketing Automation Manager
location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
description: En Teldat buscamos a una persona que haga crecer el valor de nuestra base de clientes.  Serás responsable de diseñar, ejecutar y medir campañas automatizadas a partir de los datos de licencias SaaS. Tu objetivo: que nuestros clientes renueven, continúen con nosotros y descubran nuevas soluciones.  Es un puesto con visión de negocio y manos en la herramienta. Definirás la estrategia del ciclo de vida del cliente y construirás los flujos, las reglas y los informes que la hagan funcionar.      Qué harás    Estrategia    Analizar, adaptar y priorizar las campañas del ciclo de vida del cliente (renovación, retención, upselling y cross selling).  Definir la segmentación de audiencias a partir de los datos de licencias SaaS y del comportamiento de los clientes.    Planificación    Elaborar el calendario de campañas, teniendo en cuenta los ciclos de renovación y los nuevos desarrollos de producto.  Preparar las comunicaciones desde el CRM y la herramienta de emailing: campos personalizados, sincronización de datos, listas dinámicas, etc.  Diseñar flujos y reglas de automatización.    Ejecución    Lanzar y mantener las campañas de renovación, engagement y upselling sobre licencias SaaS.  Planificar y lanzar las comunicaciones sobre nuevos desarrollos de producto.  Aplicar reglas que eviten solapamientos entre campañas y saturación de los contactos.  Generar tareas o alertas para el equipo comercial cuando un cliente muestre determinadas señales (por ejemplo, proximidad de renovación o baja interacción).  Realizar tests A/B de emails para mejorar de forma continua los resultados.    Medición    Crear un cuadro de mandos para medir e interpretar los resultados de las campañas.  Elaborar un reporte mensual con los KPIs definidos, incluyendo conclusiones y propuestas de mejora.       A quién buscamos    Experiencia en marketing B2B con al menos una plataforma de marketing automation y un CRM.  Dominio práctico de  Salesforce y Account Engagement (Pardot) , o de una plataforma equivalente.  Perfil que combine pensamiento estratégico (journey del cliente, retención, negocio) con dominio técnico-operativo (herramientas de automation, lógica de datos) y atención al detalle en la ejecución.  Capacidad analítica para tomar decisiones basadas en datos.  Inglés alto, escrito y oral, para trabajar con equipos internacionales.       Valorable    Experiencia en empresas de software o tecnología con modelo de licencias o suscripción.  Conocimiento de ABM y de scoring o grading de cuentas y contactos.  Experiencia en herramientas de BI o dashboards       Qué ofrecemos    Salario competitivo.  Flexibilidad horaria.  Planes de Compensación Flexible: seguro médico, guardería, transporte, comida, entre otros.  Plan de Formación y 2 horas semanales de clases de inglés.  22 días de vacaciones + 3 días libres + 8 horas de libre disposición.  Desarrollo profesional en una línea estratégica para Teldat. title: CX & Quality Manager
description: Atlantigo es un grupo de empresas que conforman una solución integral para construir el futuro de los riesgos de viaje.      Intermundial: líderes en distribución de seguros de viaje y gadget.  Servisegur: expertos en servicios asociados al seguro de viaje.  Mana: experiencia e innovación en la gestión del riesgo turístico.  Tourism & Law: asesoramiento legal preventivo para empresas turísticas.      Este es el propósito que, desde hace más de 30 años, nos impulsa a seguir trabajando, innovando, aprendiendo y creciendo para crear las soluciones más completas de riesgos de viaje, que potencien el sector del turismo y garanticen al viajero una experiencia única.     Actualmente estamos buscando un Buscamos incorporar un/a  CX & Quality Manager  para liderar la función corporativa de Customer Experience y Calidad del Grupo.  La posición tendrá dependencia directa de Dirección General y asumirá la responsabilidad de definir, desarrollar y consolidar el modelo corporativo de Customer Experience y Calidad, integrando la voz del cliente, el análisis de datos y el conocimiento de la operación para identificar oportunidades de mejora, impulsar iniciativas transversales y garantizar la medición de su impacto.  Se trata de una posición de carácter estratégico y transversal, con capacidad de interlocución con las principales áreas de la organización y con responsabilidad sobre la evolución del modelo de CX y Calidad a nivel corporativo.     Principales responsabilidades     Estrategia y gobierno de Customer Experience y Calidad   Definir y desarrollar la estrategia corporativa de Customer Experience y Calidad, alineada con la estrategia y prioridades del Grupo.  Establecer estándares, metodologías, indicadores y modelos de seguimiento para la gestión de CX y Calidad.  Diseñar y mantener un roadmap corporativo de iniciativas, estableciendo prioridades, responsables, plazos e indicadores de impacto.  Coordinar el gobierno transversal de las iniciativas de CX y Calidad y realizar el seguimiento de su evolución.  Liderar la interlocución con las diferentes áreas de negocio y elevar a Dirección General los principales riesgos, oportunidades y decisiones requeridas.  Promover una cultura de mejora continua y orientación al cliente en el conjunto de la organización.      Voz del cliente, análisis y reporting ejecutivo   Integrar y analizar las diferentes fuentes de información relacionadas con la experiencia del cliente: NPS, encuestas, reclamaciones, reseñas, incidencias, Speech Analytics, métricas operativas y observación directa.  Identificar tendencias, fricciones y oportunidades de mejora mediante el análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo.  Profundizar en las causas de los problemas detectados y contrastar las hipótesis antes de formular recomendaciones.  Segmentar la información por servicios, canales, productos, mercados y perfiles de cliente, cuando resulte relevante.  Elaborar informes y presentaciones ejecutivas orientados a la toma de decisiones.

title: Taloushallinnon palvelupäällikkö, Oulun seutu
description: Oletko esihenkilötyön ammattilainen ja valmiina luotsaamaan alansa huippuasiantuntijoiden tiimiä? Rantalainen on Suomen johtava ja voimakkaasti kasvava asiantuntijaorganisaatio talous- ja palkkahallintoalan palveluliiketoiminnassa. Rantalainen palvelee yli 100 eri toimipisteellä Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa. Palvelupäällikkönä toimit esihenkilönä ja tukena 14 taloushallinnon asiantuntijan tiimillesi sekä vastaat tiimisi työn organisoinnista, palvelutoiminnan ohjauksesta ja tuloksesta. Tiimiisi kuuluu niin pitkän kokemuksen omaavia taloushallinnon asiantuntijoita kuin alalla uudempia osaajiakin. Ohjaat kannustavalla ja innostavalla otteella tiimiäsi sekä olet mukana kehittämässä Rantalaisen toimintaa. Tukenasi tehtävässä toimivat muut palvelupäälliköt ja alueesi palvelujohtaja, jolle myös raportoit.     Tiimisi työskentelee hybridimallissa Oulun seudun toimipisteillä (Muhos, Kello ja Kempele), joissa toivomme palvelupäälliköltä läsnäoloa vähintään muutamana päivänä viikossa.      Mitä Rantalainen tarjoaa sinulle?      Rantalaisella tarjoamme sinulle kiinnostavan ja vastuullisen roolin, jossa saat aidosti oman kädenjälkesi näkyviin, Suomen johtavassa talous- ja palkkahallintoalan yrityksessä. Saat meillä asiantuntevan organisaation sisäisen tuen työhösi, jatkuvat koulutusmahdollisuudet ja nykyaikaiset työvälineet, kuten sähköpöydän etätyöskentelyyn. Joustavana työnantajana tarjoamme sinulle vapauden suunnitella omaa työtäsi, liukuvan työajan ja etätyömahdollisuuden, jotta työn ja muiden elämän osa-alueiden yhdistäminen olisi sujuvaa.     Haluamme olla talous- ja palkkahallintoalan paras työpaikka nyt ja tulevaisuudessa ja johtomme on sitoutunut tähän tavoitteeseen! Rantalaisella jokaista työntekijää arvostetaan omana itsenään ja sinua odottaakin meillä hyvä työympäristö sekä reilu arvomaailma. Meillä panostetaan laadukkaaseen esihenkilötyöhön ja uramahdollisuuksiin talon sisällä. Tutustu kattaviin etuihimme sekä Rantalaiseen työnantajana  sivuillamme  ja käy kurkkaamassa palvelupäällikkönä työskentelevän Suvin  uratarina .      Mitä toivomme sinulta?      Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy kaupallisen alan tutkinto, kokemusta menestyksekkäästä esihenkilötyöstä sekä innostusta ihmisläheiseen työhön. title: CHARGÉ(E) DE CLIENTÈLE
description: À propos de nous   Byblos Events Security, filiale de Byblos Group, met son expertise au service de la sécurisation des événements. Pensée comme une structure agile et spécialisée, la filiale adopte une approche novatrice tant dans sa méthodologie de travail que dans le pilotage opérationnel. Production de reportings réguliers à destination de la Direction et des clients.     ORGANISATION DU TEMPS DE TRAVAIL      Poste à temps plein – 35 heures hebdomadaires.   Horaires de travail définis selon l’organisation de la filiale. Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou emploi) sur un poste équivalent est appréciée.     COMPETENCES ET QUALITES    Compétences clés     Excellentes capacités relationnelles et sens du service client

title: Junior Customer Success Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Hejsa! 👋   At du har fundet vej hertil, betyder nok, at du vil vide mere om rollen som  Junior   Customer Success Manager . Det er vi glade for - vi mangler nemlig dig! Men først får du lige en kort intro til, hvem vi er, og hvorfor vi gør det, vi gør.  Resights blev skabt med en ret simpel idé: At samle ejendomsdata ét sted, så vores kunder kan spare tid og træffe bedre beslutninger. Slut med rodede regneark og mavefornemmelser 😵‍💫 Siden da har vi, i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder, udviklet platformen massivt. I dag bruges Resights til alt fra at finde investeringsejendomme og analysere markeder og transaktioner samt finde nye fremtidige projekter. Fællesnævneren er ejendomsdata og vores mission om at gøre det muligt for kunderne at drive endnu mere forretning.  Så ja, det  er  Resights. Men i virkeligheden er det vigtigste de 51 mennesker bag platformen - et hold af passionerede nørder og teamspillere, der på fem år har bygget en hurtigt voksende scaleup med over 1.400 kunder. Og vigtigst af alt: Vi har haft det virkelig sjovt undervejs!   Om dig   Vi tror ikke på lange kravlister, men vi har stadig forventninger til dig! Dygtighed kan komme både med erfaring og med frisk energi – og vi værdsætter begge dele. Når det er sagt, vil drømmescenariet være, at du har 1-2 års erfaring fra B2B i en kundevendt rolle, hvor du er vant til at forstå og håndtere kundebehov eller på anden vis har håndteret kundedialoger.   Din mission   Der er ét afgørende succeskriterium i rollen: At vores kunder får det fulde udbytte af Resights og forbliver abonnenter.  Hvordan gør vi så det? Lad os sætte nogle ord på dine opgaver som Junior Customer Success Manager.  Du får ansvaret for din egen portefølje på ca. 300 kunder, som du skal sikre får glæde af Resights i deres daglige arbejde. Nogle kræver kun en kort onboarding, andre har brug for mere løbende sparring. Derfor er din proaktivitet nøglen. Du skal kunne arbejde struktureret og samtidig have mange bolde i luften.  Du kan selvfølgelig ikke være på fornavn med 300 mennesker - derfor understøtter vi dig med solide værktøjer og et produktteam på 20 specialister. De giver dig bl.a. dyb indsigt i kundernes brugsmønstre via vores “health score”, så du ved, hvor der er risiko, og hvor der ligger potentiale.  For at skabe reel kundesucces skal du være nysgerrig på kundernes hverdag, processer og udfordringer og hvordan du kan hjælpe dem med implementering af Resights samt opsætte relevante søgninger. Vi arbejder med alle, der rører ved fast ejendom - fra store investorer til enkeltmandsvirksomheden, der leder efter huse til varmepumpeinstallationer. Derfor er vores CS-specialister typisk både forretningsorienterede og gode til at forstå, hvordan Resights skaber værdi på tværs af kundetyper og brancher.  Rollen får ansvaret for en stor del af vores mindre, men vigtige kunder – derfor skal du være skarp i aktiveringsarbejde, proaktiv support og forlængelsesdialoger.   Dine ansvarsområder     Ansvar for din egen kundep

title: Account Manager, Restaurant
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: About Wolt   At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.  At Wolt, we’re all about great partnerships – and that starts with great people. We’re now looking for a new SMB Account Manager to join our team and help some of Denmark’s most exciting local restaurants thrive on Wolt. If you love building relationships, spotting growth opportunities, and driving impact, this might be the role for you. Since launching in Denmark in 2017, we’ve expanded to over 200 cities and partnered with 4,000+ restaurants – and we’re just getting started. Our Account Management team plays a key role in that journey, working closely with our partners to ensure their success on our platform. We’re a tight-knit team of 11 Account Managers who support and challenge each other every day. We celebrate wins, share learnings, and enjoy solving problems together – whether that’s out in the field with a partner or over a coffee at the office. If you enjoy taking ownership and being part of a humble yet ambitious team, we think you’ll feel right at home. But don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself what your future colleagues say about working at Wolt here.  What you’ll be doing  As an Account Manager at Wolt, you’ll be responsible for managing and developing a portfolio of around 150 restaurant partners. Your main goal will be to help them grow their business on our platform by identifying opportunities, solving challenges, and making sure they get the most out of Wolt’s tools and services. You’ll work closely with your partners to improve their performance, introduce relevant products like Wolt Ads or Wolt+, and support them in their day-to-day operations. This is a role that combines commercial thinking, data-driven decisions, and direct collaboration with partners.   Day-to-day in this role you’ll:     Spend 5–10 days per month visiting restaurant partners to strengthen relationships and better understand their business  Manage commercial renegotiations and drive adoption of relevant Wolt products such as Wolt+, Wolt Ads, Wolt Drive, and Wolt Capital  Use data to identify growth opportunities and guide partners through improvements that drive performance  Support partners with day-to-day operational topics and process improvements  Monitor performance using Looker and prioritise where to focus your time and

title: Slutbrugerspecialist – Bosch Power Tools
description: Vil du kombinere din tekniske forståelse med salg og stærke kunderelationer og samtidig repræsentere et af verdens førende brands inden for professionelt elværktøj?  Så er du måske vores nye Slutbrugerspecialist i Bosch Power Tools med ansvar for   Midtjylland.      Bosch er en af verdens førende teknologi- og servicevirksomheder, og Bosch Power Tools er blandt de globale markedsledere inden for elværktøj, haveværktøj og måleværktøj. Divisionen har omkring 17.300 medarbejdere og omsatte i 2025 for cirka 5 mia. EUR. Innovation spiller en central rolle, og ambitionen er løbende at udvikle nye løsninger, der er med til at sætte standarden i branchen. Du møder kunderne i deres daglige arbejdsmiljø på byggepladser, værksteder og kontorer, hvor du rådgiver om professionelle værktøjsløsninger, demonstrerer produkter og hjælper kunderne med at finde de rette løsninger til deres behov.    Du får en selvstændig hverdag med stor kontaktflade og arbejder med alt fra håndværkere og formænd til projektledere, indkøbere og virksomhedsledere.     Dine primære arbejdsopgaver      Opsøgende salg og rådgivning til professionelle kunder inden for håndværk, byggeri og industri.  Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på tilbud og kundeaftaler.  Gennemførelse af produktdemonstrationer, træning og præsentationer for kunder, samarbejdspartnere og kolleger.  Identificering og udvikling af nye forretningsmuligheder i distriktet.  Planlægning og deltagelse i messer, events, kundearrangementer og salgsaktiviteter.  Tæt koordinering og samarbejde med kolleger for at sikre en god kundeoplevelse.     Kvalifikationer    For at blive en succes i rollen, forestiller vi os at du har nedenstående profil:     Faglige kompetencer:       Har en håndværksmæssig baggrund som eksempelvis elektriker, mekaniker, struktør eller lignende kombineret med kommerciel erfaring,  eller  har en relevant salgsuddannelse og dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-salg.  Har erfaring fra bygge- og anlægsbranchen eller industrien.  Besidder et solidt kendskab til professionelle værktøjer og tekniske produkter.  Er erfaren bruger af Microsoft Office, herunder Outlook, Excel og PowerPoint.  Har gyldigt kørekort, kategori B.    Personlige kompetencer:       Er relationsskabende, selvstændig og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem opsøgende salgsarbejde.  Trives i en hverdag med stor frihed, mange kundekontakter og et højt aktivitetsniveau.  Kommunikerer godt på dansk og behersker engelsk på brugerniveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt. Vi investerer i din udvikling gennem grundig produkt- og salgstræning samt løbende kompetenceudvikling. Du tilbydes en konkurrencedy

title: Photonics Account Manager – 100%
description: Are you passionate about turning complex customer engagements into seamless, high-trust partnerships? At Lightium, we're pioneering next-generation photonic integrated circuits (PICs) built on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and we're looking for a Photonics Account Manager to serve as the backbone of our customer relationships, from purchase order entry through interfacing with our R&D team to long-term production agreements.      Position Summary   In this role, you'll join our Commercial Team, reporting to the CRO, and take ownership of the customer journey from project onboarding through delivery and after-sales expansion. You'll run structured customer touchpoints, coordinate across our internal operations and design teams, and ensure every MPW run is delivered on time, keeping every customer up to date on project status. Your work will be the bridgehead between Lightium's technical execution and our customers' confidence in Lightium as its prime photonics foundry partner.      Key Responsibilities    Customer Journey Ownership:  Lead major customer engagements with Lightium’s foundry services, from kick-off and design submission to DRC report, regular update meetings, as well as shipment, invoicing, and after-sales support. Ensure customers always know where they stand thanks to your remarkable organization and communication skills.   Run Management & Internal Coordination:  Track deliverables and open items across multiple simultaneous runs. title: Head of Key Account Management
description: Hansen Toft søger på vegne af en anonym virksomhed       International B2B-servicevirksomhed   Virksomheden er en del af en international koncern. Forretningen bygger på langvarige kunderelationer, løbende aftaler og en landsdækkende driftsorganisation.  Virksomheden er beliggende i Storkøbenhavnsområdet.      Head of Key Account Management       Strategisk kundeudvikling, ledelse og komplekse forhandlinger   Som Head of Key Account Management får du ansvar for at lede og udvikle KAM-funktionen og sætte retningen for samarbejdet med virksomhedens største kunder. Du skal bygge videre på teamets salgserfaring og etablere en fælles arbejdsform med klare prioriteringer, strategiske account-planer og bedre anvendelse af data og kundeindsigt.     Du refererer direkte til salgsdirektøren og bliver en tæt sparringspartner om kommerciel udvikling og gennemførelse af forandringer. Du leder et team af salgsmedarbejdere med ansvar for både udvikling af eksisterende kunder og tilgang af nye større kunder.     Du deltager selv i de vigtigste kundedialoger og forhandlinger og hjælper teamet med at skabe stærke, langsigtede aftaler. Samtidig får du en central opgave i at styrke samarbejdet henimod Operations på tværs af organisationen.     Af andre nøgleopgaver kan nævnes:  ● Omsætte virksomhedens strategi til kundesegmentering, prioriteringer og konkrete planer for KAM-området.  ● Lede, coache og udvikle teamet gennem tydelige mål og løbende opfølgning.  ● Udvikle og implementere en fælles KAM-model med account-planer, mødestruktur og rammer for forhandling og kontraktstyring.  ● Øge salget af flere produktkategorier hos den enkelte kunde samt styrke samarbejdet med fokus på at reducere churn blandt de større kunder.  ● Styrke kommercielle vilkår gennem forhandlinger, genforhandlinger og udbud med fokus på priser, rabatstruktur og reguleringsmekanismer.  ● Sikre en systematisk indsats for at vinde nye større kunder og udvikle eksisterende samarbejder gennem værdibaseret salg og krydssalg.  ● Anvende data, CRM, forecasts og KPI’er til at kvalificere kundedialogen og følge op på resultaterne.  ● Samarbejde med nationale og internationale kolleger om kunder, leverancer og udvikling af fælles arbejdsformer.      Kommerciel leder med tyngde i forhandlinger   Du har en relevant kommerciel videregående uddannelse, gerne på kandidatniveau. Du har solid erfaring med strategisk key account management og komplekst B2B-salg til større kunder. Din branchebaggrund er mindre afgørende end dit salgshåndværk, din forhandlingserfaring og din evne til at skabe resultater gennem andre.     Du er vant til at forhandle med indkøbschefer og topledelse og har erfaring med kontrakter, genforhandlinger, både private og offentlige udbud. Du har arbejdet struktureret med account-planer og kan omsætte en overordnet strategi til konkrete indsatser og resultater hos kunderne.  Du har erfaring med at lede sælgere eller KAM’er og motiveres af at udvikle deres kompetencer og selvstændighed.

description: エンタープライズのデータ・AI変革を、構想から実装・定着・拡張まで統括するコンサルティング＆サクセスサービス領域の執行役員を募集！      ◼︎私たちについて  Quollio Technologies（Quollio）は、企業・機関のデータガバナンス確立とAI活用の高度化を支援する、データテクノロジー・カンパニーです。大規模なメタデータ管理やデータカタログの構築を中心に、業務上の意味や関係を体系化するセマンティック管理までを実現する、Quollio Data Intelligence Cloudを提供しています。  企業がAIを活用していくためにはAIモデルそのものだけでなく、「AIに何のデータを使わせるのか」「そのデータは信頼できるのか」「社内の誰がどのデータを管理しているのか」を、また「業務上の工程はどう関連しているか」「業務ルールやメトリクスはどういった前提か」「業務とデータはどう紐づいているか」などを明確にすることが重要です。この企業理解のための「新しいナレッジ資源」をAIが活用できる状態にしておくことが重要です。  創業から短期間でデータカタログ市場において国産ベンダーNo.1／国内シェア2位を達成、現在ではセマンティック・オントロジー領域への提供範囲の拡大しながら、日本を代表する企業様への導入も着実に進めております。     ◼︎募集の背景  今後さらにエンタープライズ領域での事業成長を目指す中で、プロダクトの提供にとどまらず、顧客企業の経営・事業課題に深く入り込み、データ・AIを活用した変革を実際の成果につなげることに挑戦しています。     そこで今回、製品知識を超えて、デプロイメントストラテジー、プロフェッショナルサービス、カスタマーサクセスマネジメントを一体化し、顧客への価値提供をさらに高めることに挑戦すべく、エンタープライズ顧客への導入戦略を統括し、その組織・仕組みをつくるコンサルティング＆サクセスサービス領域の執行役員を募集します。     ◼︎ミッション  エンタープライズ企業のデータ・AI変革を、構想から実装・定着、事業価値の創出まで一気通貫でリードしていただきます。  デプロイメントストラテジー、プロフェッショナルサービス、カスタマーサクセスマネジメントを横断し、戦略策定から導入・実装、定着・活用、さらなる価値拡張まで、顧客価値の創出を統括していただきます。  また、個別プロジェクトの成功にとどまらず、顧客への価値提供戦略、組織・人材、プロセス、KPI、事業成果までを含めた顧客価値提供全体の設計・運営・成長を牽引していただきます。     ◼︎業務内容  1. エンタープライズ顧客への変革支援・価値創出  - 経営・事業・IT部門などの顧客経営層との対話を通じた、経営・事業課題の特定  - データ・AI戦略、データガバナンス、オントロジー、メタデータ基盤等に関する変革構想、ロードマップ、実行計画の策定  - 大規模かつ複雑なエンタープライズ案件における、顧客経営層との折衝を含むプロジェクト全体の統括とリスクマネジメント  - デプロイメントストラテジー、プロフェッショナルサービス、カスタマーサクセスマネジメントを横断した支援方針・デリバリーモデルの設計  -
