title: Head of CRM & Clienteling – APAC - Luxury
description: Head of CRM & Clienteling – APAC  Tokyo, Japan | Full-time     Luxury Executive is supporting an international luxury fashion house in appointing a Head of CRM & Clienteling for APAC.     This newly created role offers the opportunity to build a regional function at an important stage of the brand’s growth. The focus is to deepen client relationships, develop VIC engagement and translate a distinctive brand experience into stronger customer loyalty and commercial performance.     Based in Tokyo and reporting to the regional President, you will lead CRM and clienteling across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan and Southeast Asia. China and Hong Kong sit outside this role’s remit.      The opportunity   You will shape regional strategy while working directly with market leaders, retail teams and clients. This requires someone who can set direction, build capability and remain closely involved in execution.      Key responsibilities    Develop and execute the regional CRM and clienteling strategy, adapting programmes to different markets and customer profiles.  Strengthen client acquisition, retention, reactivation and progression into VIC segments.  Lead personalised client experiences, private appointments, events, gifting and collection-selling initiatives.  Translate CRM data and client insights into clear commercial actions and measurable results.  Establish regional performance measures and share effective practices across markets.  Build, lead and develop a growing team of CRM, clienteling and training professionals.  Coach retail teams and strengthen their confidence in developing long-term client relationships.  Partner with Marketing, Retail and headquarters to ensure a consistent and locally relevant client experience.  Manage regional budgets and support delivery through regular market and store engagement.       Your background    At least 10 years of relevant experience across luxury retail, CRM, clienteling or customer engagement, preferably within luxury fashion.  Demonstrated responsibility for CRM or clienteling strategy across multiple Asian markets.  Established senior leadership capability, with experience developing teams and influencing market stakeholders.  Strong understanding of VIC cultivation, luxury client expectations and personalised service.  Evidence of translating client engagement into measurable commercial outcomes.  Confidence working with CRM data, segmentation and performance analysis.  A practical, hands-on approach and the ability to build a function within a growing organisation.  Fluent professional English and willingness to travel regionally.  Strong fashion awareness; previous client-facing luxury retail experience is an advantage.       Location   The role is based in Tokyo. We welcome applications from candidates already in Japan and those elsewhere with relevant Asian-market experience who are willing to relocate.  Japanese is not required. Relocation support may be discussed individually.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

What you will own

  • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

If you have led embedded or hardware-adjacent teams, enjoy being the person to which a factory, a certification body and a firmware engineer all escalate in the same week, and who brings the self-organization to keep all of it moving without dropping balls, we would love to talk.

description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

title: Cdi - Head Of Production Photos E-Commerce (H/F)
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
 
Rattaché(e) au Directeur Image, Le/la Head of Production Photos E-Commerce est responsable du pilotage global des productions photographiques  destinées à l’e-commerce et au showroom.

description:
Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Amsterdam/Rotterdam, Noord en Oost Nederland

Omschrijving van het team

Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers.

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten.

In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen

title: Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition, you'll explore an important extension of how RevenueCat helps developers grow: helping them not just monetize the users they have, but acquire more of the right users in the first place.

RevenueCat already has several footholds in user acquisition, including our Apple Ads integration and integrations across the attribution and MMP ecosystem. But we're still early in defining what a broader RevenueCat user acquisition product should become. You'll be the first dedicated product hire focused on this space, reporting directly to our product lead for Ads, with significant latitude to shape both the strategy and the products we build.

This is a genuine zero-to-one role. You won't inherit a predetermined roadmap. Your job will be to deeply understand how app developers acquire users today, identify where RevenueCat has an opportunity to solve problems meaningfully better, and turn those insights into products we can test, ship, and scale.

You'll bring real expertise in mobile performance marketing and user acquisition to that process. The opportunity could eventually span attribution and measurement, products built on top of existing acquisition channels, new ways to optimize spend using downstream monetization data, partnerships, advertising infrastructure, or things we haven't considered yet. We have hypotheses, but we're hiring you in part because we want your perspective on which ones are worth pursuing.

RevenueCat has some unusual advantages to build from: relationships with a large ecosystem of app developers, deep visibility into subscription and monetization outcomes, infrastructure already embedded in apps, and a growing advertising business. The challenge is figuring out how those assets can translate into something uniquely valuable for developers trying to grow.

title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

title: Tender Manager
description:
Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributio

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

title: AI Engineer - Tech Stagaire
description:
Voor deze rol is Nederlands spreken een vereiste.

Wil jij de "koffie halen" stage overslaan en direct verantwoordelijkheden krijgen bij een snelgroeiende AI-agency?

Bij Surf Agency ben je geen stagiair die een beetje mag meekijken. Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheden die normaal gesproken bij een CTO liggen: van het ontwerpen van schaalbare AI-infrastructuren tot het bouwen van complexe agents die het verschil maken voor klanten. Wij zoeken een ambitieuze technische student die onze tech naar een nieuw niveau brengt!

Locatie: Rotterdam

Vergoeding: Basisvergoeding

Startdatum: In overleg

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Surf Agency, een AI-agency uit Rotterdam met één missie: Nederlandse bedrijven efficiënter maken door AI op een praktische manier te implementeren.

Wij kijken met een bedrijfskundige blik naar processen: we analyseren eerst de manier van werken van een bedrijf en maken daarna pas de vertaalslag naar AI. Op die manier slaan wij de brug tussen de nieuwste AI-technologie en het bedrijfsleven. Lees meer op de “over ons” pagina.

Onze cultuur

Sinds onze start in mei 2025 groeien we hard en bouwen we aan een jonge, dynamische cultuur. Bij Surf Agency vind je geen ‘zesjes-mentaliteit’; wij streven altijd naar het allerbeste resultaat waar we zelf trots op kunnen zijn.

  • Pioniers: We brengen een frisse, jonge blik en dagen de gevestigde orde uit door dingen op onze eigen manier te doen
  • Ondernemend: We bieden een plek waar je de vrijheid hebt om te ondernemen en mee te bouwen aan een bedrijf in de meest spannende sector van dit moment.
  • Inclusief & Open: Een plek waar je kunt groeien, verantwoordelijkheden krijgt en kunt leren.

title: Client Solutions Manager (Ads)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요    토스의 Client Solutions Manager는 광고사업부에 속해 있어요.  광고사업부는 동영상 광고, 배너광고 등 토스라는 플랫폼을 활용한 광고 사업을 담당합니다.  광고사업부는 다양한 광고 및 제휴 상품을 담당하면서, 광고주 대상 프로모션 전략과 다양한 혜택 기획, 수수료 협상 등 광고 사업에 관련한 모든 전략적인 의사결정을 이끌고 있어요.  광고사업부의 목표는 지속적으로 고객사의 토스 광고 상품 집행을 통해 매출을 증대시켜 나가면서, 동시에 토스와 고객사의 동반 성장을 도모하는 것이에요.      합류하면 함께 할 업무에요    주요 고객의 마케팅 목적과 캠페인 KPI에 맞추어, 토스의 광고 제품을 활용한 최적화 솔루션을 제안해요.  고객의 성공을 위한 데이터를 분석하고, 장기적으로 토스를 활용할 수 있는 전략을 수립해요.   Data Analyst와 협업하여 데이터 기반의 전략 솔루션을 개발하고, 고객에게 효과적으로 컨설팅해요.  토스의 광고 제품을 잘 활용할 수 있도록 고객들에게 토스 활용에 대한 Best Practice를 제안하고 실행해요.  트렌드를 반영한 새로운 광고 활용 방안을 발굴하고, 토스를 통해 성장할 수 있도록 지원해요.  토스의 고객들과 지속적인 피드백과 성과 리뷰를 통해 관계를 강화하고, 파트너십을 증진시켜요.      이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    광고 산업에 대한 이해도가 높고, 광고/마케팅 경험이 5년 이상 필요합니다.  광고 분야에서 전략 수립과 업셀링을 통해 성과와 매출을 만들어본 경험이 있으면 더욱 좋습니다.  커뮤니케이션 역량이 뛰어나며 대외적 마케팅 및 홍보 활동 경험을 해보신 분이면 좋습니다.  데이터 분석 및 이해도를 바탕으로 업무를 수행하시고, 전략적 사고를 통한 문제 해결 경험이 있으신 분을 찾습니다.      이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요    성과를 내기 위해서 본인이 주도적으로 진행해 보신 경험이 있다면 구체적으로 적어주세요.  데이터 기반의 최적화 솔루션 제안을 통해 달성하신 수치적인 성과(예산 증액 등)가 있다면 구체적으로 적어주세요.      토스로의 합류여정    서류접수 > 전화인터뷰 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사      함께할 동료를 위한 한마디  “주도적이고 성장을 추구하는 역량 있는 분들을 환영합니다!!”  토스에서는 누군가 정한 방식대로 일하는 게 아닌, 모든 구성원이 같은 방향을 바라보며 스스로 생각하고 판단해요. 광고비즈팀은 계속해서 성장하고 있기 때문에 도전할 수 있는 기회가 많고, 스스로의 내린 결정으로부터 큰 동기부여와 성취감을 얻을 수 있어요. Client Solutions Manager는 고객사의 성장을 위해 토스를 효율적으로 활용하기 위한 전략과 인사이트를 제공합니다. 주도적으로 비즈니스를 이끌고 함께 성장을 만들고 싶은 분이라면 재밌게 일할 수 있을 것이라 자신해요!

title: Manager - Outreach Engagement
description: Job Description   The Member Outreach Manager leads the team responsible for member outreach, education, enrolment, and ongoing engagement in CareConnect health programs. The role drives consultation bookings and completion, supports member retention across follow-up cycles, and ensures a consistent member experience through effective team management, performance monitoring, and coordination with clinical and operational teams.  Key Accountabilities:  1- Member Outreach, Education and Enrollment;    Lead proactive member outreach to introduce CareConnect services and explain program benefits.  Ensure eligible members receive timely contact and follow-up to support enrollment in appropriate programs.  identify the member’s specific needs, goals, and pain points.  Develop targeted outreach plans aligned with departmental objectives, using appropriate member segments, timing, and channels.    2- Team Leadership and Operational Management;    Allocate team and individual targets and manage workloads and staffing coverage.  Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development discussions.  Identify training needs and address performance gaps.  Ensure team adherence to approved workflows and service standards.    3- Consultation Booking, Completion and Retention;    Oversee initial and repeat consultation bookings; monitor completion and no-shows; manage reminders, cancellations, and rebooking, track members due for subsequent CCM cycles; support use of the app for future bookings.    4- Onboarding and Member Journey Coordination;    Develop and oversee an efficient, comprehensive onboarding process tailored to member needs.  Communicate the onboarding process and expected timelines to new members.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., RCM, Medical team, technical teams) to create a seamless onboarding experience.  Coordinate with Care Navigators and ICS to support member follow-up, track pending services, and escalate unresolved issues.  Ensure timely member updates and route medical queries to the clinical team.    5- Performance Monitoring and Reporting;    Monitor and analyze team performance across calls, reachability, enrollment, bookings, consultation completion, retention, and quality.  Maintain accurate dashboards and provide timely performance reports.  Identify performance gaps, implement corrective actions, and report progress to the department lead    6- Quality, Continuous Improvement and Digital Enablement;    Support the implementation of AI-powered engagement tools, including AI voice agents, automated follow-ups, and escalation to CE agents.  Identify system enhancement requirements based on operational gaps and member needs, and coordinate with IT and relevant stakeholders.  Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), validate workflows, and coordinate team training and adoption. title: Customer Protection Manager
description: About The Role    Position Overview :    The Customer Protection Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring SOAR’s customer protection framework to ensure fair treatment, transparent disclosures, effective complaint handling, and compliance with applicable Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements.The role works closely with Compliance, Legal, Operations, Product, Technology, Credit, Collections, and Customer Support to identify customer-impact risks, resolve complaints fairly, and strengthen customer trust throughout the customer journey.    Key Responsibilities :     Customer Protection and Regulatory Compliance     Develop and maintain customer protection policies, procedures, and controls aligned with applicable SAMA Financial Consumer Protection Principles and Rules.  Monitor fair and equitable treatment of customers throughout onboarding, financing applications, contracting, servicing, collections, and account closure.  Review customer-facing communications, product disclosures, fees, terms and conditions, and digital journeys to ensure clarity, accuracy, and transparency.  Monitor regulatory developments and coordinate the implementation of applicable requirements.     Complaints Management     Oversee the end-to-end customer complaints process, including registration, investigation, resolution, communication, escalation, and documentation.  Ensure complaints are handled fairly, consistently, and within applicable regulatory timelines.  Investigate recurring complaints, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with relevant departments.  Maintain accurate complaint records and ensure appropriate retention of supporting evidence.  Establish clear escalation procedures for unresolved complaints and material customer-impact issues.     Customer Experience and Fair Treatment     Identify potential customer harm across SOAR’s products, services, and digital channels.  Review customer journeys to ensure customers understand product features, obligations, fees, risks, and contractual terms.  Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure customers experiencing financial difficulties are treated fairly and assessed in accordance with applicable requirements and approved policies.  Promote accessible, clear, and consistent customer communications.  Recommend improvements based on customer feedback, complaints, and service-quality trends.     Monitoring and Reporting     Develop customer protection dashboards and key performance indicators.  Prepare periodic management reports covering complaints, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, recurring issues, and remediation progress.  Conduct quality reviews of complaint handling and customer interactions.  Track corrective actions and escalate overdue or material issues to senior management. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Fractile is building the next generation of AI computing technology, developing innovative hardware and software solutions designed to transform the performance and efficiency of AI workloads.

We're bringing together exceptional talent across semiconductor engineering, software, and AI to solve some of the most ambitious challenges in computing.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - French speaker
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry

title: Amazon Performance (PPC) & Automation Manager

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

Amazon brings Ledger to a broader audience of crypto-curious buyers on every continent, making it a key growth driver for the business. The Marketplaces team owns the Amazon channel end to end, from catalogue and inventory management to ads campaign management. You’ll lead our ads performance and bring a builder’s mindset to the whole channel: using data and AI to scale what works and automate our Amazon processes, from ads to operations.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrica

title: Strategic Account Executive (Zurich)
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business within your territory, focusing on building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across various personas within an account. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and ensuring successful sales outcomes through effective pipeline generation and accurate sales forecasting.

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

You report to the Production Manager, who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). description:
Your role at Veezu:

As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data platform that powers reporting, analytics and data science across Veezu. Reporting into the Director of Data Engineering, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, bringing data in from our booking systems, databases and third-party APIs and shaping it into trusted, well-modelled datasets that the business relies on every day.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric using Pipelines, Notebooks, Lakehouses, Warehouses and OneLake.

  • Write PySpark notebooks to ingest and transform data from SQL Server databases, REST APIs, SaaS applications and file-based exports.

  • Develop and optimise SQL transformations, stored procedures and Kimball-style star-schema data models.

  • Build and support Power BI semantic models and the datasets behind dashboards used by teams across the business.

  • Implement data quality, validation and reconciliation checks so numbers match across systems.

  • Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot data, performance and refresh issues.

  • Use Git, automated testing and CI/CD to support reliable, repeatable deployments.

Gain broad exposure to business challenges across industries and functional areas.   Leverage Gartner's world-class research and expert network to drive client outcomes.   Develop expertise in executive engagement, strategic partnership, and business advisory services.   Access significant opportunities for career growth and internal mobility.      Who are we? title: Customer Success Manager

Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries. title: Customer Relationship Manager – Central North Island
description: Description    About the Company   Our client is a well-established New Zealand fintech with a genuinely differentiated product and a loyal client base built over two decades. They work with thousands of New Zealand businesses and the accounting firms that serve them, helping clients manage their financial obligations more efficiently and cost effectively. It’s a company undergoing significant change with a purpose-led ownership structure that sets it apart from most fintechs.   The Role   Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will own a portfolio of accounting-firm and business relationships across the Central North Island, protecting and growing revenue through genuine account management. Based in the region and covering Gisborne, Hawke’s Bay, Manawatu, Whanganui and Taranaki, you will have real ownership of your territory and the scope to deepen relationships and grow the client base, educating them on the benefits of their new innovative software product. title: Manager, CRM Category Expansion
description: ABOUT QUINCE   Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.  What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.   OUR CULTURE   Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.    We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.     If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.   THE ROLE     Manager, CRM Category Expansion   The  Manager, CRM Category Expansion  owns every scheduled brand campaign across email, SMS, push, and in-app for the UK, Germany, and France. This includes new arrivals, restocks, seasonal and gifting moments, and key discount events like Black Friday/Cyber Monday and Quince Day. These are broad, brand-wide sends that go out to the whole customer base or large segments, designed to take customers beyond the one category they already know us for and introduce them to the rest of the range. Après l'acquisition réussie de NSF (Nuit Sans Folie) en 2020, et notre expansion en Italie, Espagne et Allemagne, nous cherchons à renforcer notre équipe avec des talents passionnés pour poursuivre notre aventure internationale.       Nos valeurs :  Liberté, Respect, Responsabilité. Elles ne sont pas de simples mots, mais le fondement de notre culture d'entreprise.      Chez Koala Interactive, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler dans un environnement qui valorise votre créativité et autonomie, tout en respectant votre équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle grâce au télétravail.       Rôle        Le/la Customer Success Manager est garant.e de la performance et de la conformité de l'ensemble de notre dispositif de support et de modération, en pilotant à la fois les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe.       Ton obsession :  coacher et motiver ton équipe au quotidien afin d'assurer la satisfaction de nos utilisateurs, tout en garantissant que nos processus de modération restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables (règlement sur les services numériques, Arcom).      Tu es également garant.e de l'amélioration continue des processus de traitement des demandes utilisateurs et de modération de contenus.      Last but not least : tu portes la voix du client à travers l'organisation et particulièrement auprès de l'équipe Produit pour intégrer à notre roadmap les demandes et suggestions des utilisateurs.       Missions et Responsabilités           Garantir la qualité du service  fourni par les équipes internes et notre prestataire externe afin de satisfaire nos utilisateurs  Être garant.e de la  conformité juridique  de notre dispositif de modération au regard du règlement sur les services numériques (RSN/DSA) et des exigences de l'Arcom : mise à jour des procédures, traçabilité des décisions, coordination avec la Direction Juridique  Superviser la  chaîne d’escalade des demandes et signalements , notamment les cas complexes, sensibles ou présentant un enjeu juridique, et coordonner si nécessaire les signalements aux autorités compétentes. description: ValidIT  har förtroendet att rekrytera en  Technical Account Manager (TAM)  till vår kund i  Göteborg . Låter det intressant,  då tycker jag du skall fortsätta läsa hela annonsen. title: カスタマーサクセス（Mid Market）｜札幌
description: 飲食の未来を、テクノロジーで切り拓く。  友人と語り合った居酒屋の夜。家族で囲んだ食卓。初めてのデートで緊張しながら入ったレストラン。  「食べる」という体験には、いつも人生の大切な瞬間が寄り添っています。  日本の外食産業は25兆円規模。ミシュラン星付きレストランの数は世界一。  しかしその裏側では、高い倒産率、深刻な人手不足、薄い利益率——構造的な課題が山積しています。  「好きなことを仕事にしたのに、続けられない」。そんな声が溢れるこの業界を、私たちは変えたい。  All in One Restaurant Cloud.  ダイニーは「All in One Restaurant Cloud.」として、POSレジ・モバイルオーダー・CRM・シフト/勤怠管理・決済まで、飲食店経営に必要な機能をワンストップで提供しています。   「儲かるお店をつくる」  — 売上データの一元管理とCRMで、利益を最大化。   「働く人のやりがいを高める」  — 従業員の貢献度を可視化し、離職率を低減。   「金融アクセスを向上させる」  — 決済・与信で飲食店のキャッシュフローを改善。  解約率は0.5%未満。一度使ったお店が手放さないプロダクトで、急成長を実現しています。  AIエージェントで、経営そのものを自動化する。  2026年7月、ダイニーはAIエージェント事業を本格始動しました。  売上照合・日次PL・請求書管理・不正操作検知など、飲食企業のバックオフィスに残る人手依存の業務を、AIエージェントが自動化する新プロダクト群です。  POS・モバイルオーダーで蓄積したデータと、数多くの飲食企業との接点を持つダイニーだからこそ、実際の顧客課題を起点にAIを社会実装できる。  「All in One Restaurant Cloud」の先へ——AIエージェントとともに、飲食業の真のインフラを目指します。  現場に立つ。1次情報を、自分の目で。  ダイニーには「シフトイン」という文化があります。  プロダクトチームが実際に飲食店のシフトに入り、厨房やホールに立つ。オーダーを受け、料理を運び、お客様の表情を見る。  会議室では見えない現場のリアルを、自分の体で理解する。   この「1次情報を自分の足で取りに行く」顧客志向の徹底が、ダイニーの競争力の源泉です。   AI Native — 自分たち自身も、テクノロジーで進化する。  ダイニーは全社員がAIを日常業務に実装する「AI Nativeカンパニー」です。  毎週AI勉強会を開催し、エンジニアだけでなくHR・CS・セールス、全員がAIを使いこなします。  あらゆるプロセスにAIが組み込まれ、少数精鋭で圧倒的な生産性を実現。  飲食業界をテクノロジーで変えると言いながら、自分たちの働き方が旧態依然では説得力がない。   だから私たちは、自らが最も先進的な働き方を実践します。   Mission・Vision・Values   Mission：「"飲食"をもっと楽しくおもしろく。」    Vision：「全ての人の"飲食"インフラになる。」   "飲食"は、人々が心を通わすために欠かせないもの。  外食産業はGDPの5%を占める経済の屋台骨であり、世界に誇る日本の象徴的な文化です。  私たちはテクノロジーを活用し、この尊い産業を支え、よりやりがいがあり、おもしろいものに発展させていきます。   真心をこめる  — 関わるすべての人に、真剣に尽くす心で。   事に向き合う  — 固定観念にとらわれず、本質を見極めて。   魂を燃やす  — 圧倒的な情熱と貪欲さで、物事に取り組む。  メガベンチャー、コンサルファーム、飲食業界出身者——多様なバックグラウンドを持つ125名が、東京・大阪・札幌・名古屋の4拠点で活躍中。  経営ボードミーティングは全て英語。日本発、世界で戦えるエクセレントカンパニーを目指しています。  参考資料   ■ ダイニー採用情報   https://www.notion.so/diniinote/4f1f4687b47a48ee9de7abbe5a1f3814   ■ カルチャーデック   https://speakerdeck.com/diniiofficial/dinii-company-deck-ver-dot-1-0-2024   ■ ダイニーの道のりと今後のビジョンについて（PIVOT登壇）   https://t.co/5tjKbEClU5   ■ ダイニー社員食堂（note記事）   https://note.com/dinii/m/m82d04c587a4c  ミッション  これから店舗を増やしていく成長中の飲食企業に対し、システムを通じた「売上が上がる仕組みづくり」を支援することが最大のミッションです。  これまで「ベテラン店長の勘」に頼っていたお店づくりをデータで可視化し、経験の浅いスタッフでもリピーターを獲得できる運用ルールを一緒に構築します。  日々のコンサルティングを通じ、注文の取り方を見直して1人あたりの売上を1,000円分押し上げたり、データを使った販促で再来店率を30%アップさせ、結果としてお店の月間売上が3倍に成長した実績もあります。ツールの使い方の案内にとどまらず、経営陣と二人三脚で企業の事業拡大を最前線で支えるやりがいのあるポジションです。  募集背景  「ダイニー」の導入店舗が全国で急増する中、これから店舗数を拡大していく成長企業のお客様から「データを活用して、法人全体の売上を改善する仕組みを作りたい」という期待の声が数多く寄せられています。  このご要望にさらに応えていくため、お客様の事業課題に寄り添い、成長を共に喜べる新たな仲間を募集することになりました。  ”データ分析”や”コンサルティング”と聞くと難しく感じるかもしれませんが、分析のノウハウやツールの使い方は入社後にチーム全体でしっかりサポートします。「ITの力で外食業界をもっと良くしたい」という熱意があれば大丈夫です。未経験からカスタマーサクセスのプロフェッショナルとして、一緒にキャリアを築いていきましょう！  業務内容  初期設定や基本的な操作レクチャーを行う「オンボーディング専任チーム」からお客様を引き継ぎ、システムが稼働した後の「定着・売上アップの支援（アダプション）」から伴走をスタートします。    状況把握と目標のすり合わせ    まずは引き継いだ飲食企業（社長やエリアマネージャー）と対話し、「システムを使ってチェーン全体をどう良くしていくか」という目標を共有。それを実現するためのスケジュールを一緒に組み立てます。    データに基づく改善提案    各店舗でシステムが無理なく使われているかを確認し、蓄積されたデータを分析します。「A店の成功ノウハウを他店舗にも広める」「雨の日は自動で特典クーポンを配信する」など、チェーン全体の売上やリピーターを増やすための具体的なアドバイスを定期的に行います。    さらなる事業拡大のサポート    お客様の事業成長に寄り添い、新店舗をオープンする際の追加導入をサポー

title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist - Network Experience
description: CiscoのCustomer Experience（CX）組織は、急速に成長を遂げているチームであり、顧客がCiscoの投資から実質的かつ持続的な価値を引き出せるよう支援することを使命としています。私たちは技術的知識とビジネス理解の交差点に立ち、顧客と密接に連携しながら、彼らの業務運用を改善し、重要な成果を達成するためのパートナーとして活動しています。Customer Success Specialist（CSS）チームは、深い製品知識と顧客成功への強い好奇心を持つ技術アドバイザーの集団であり、顧客と共に歩み、単なる傍観者ではなく積極的に導く役割を担っています。ネットワーク、セキュリティ、クラウド＆AIインフラの3つの重点分野にわたり、グローバルなコミュニティと知見を共有しながら、複雑な技術課題に取り組み、Cisco製品の継続的な改善に貢献しています。   仕事内容   顧客の環境を把握し、導入計画を作成して製品の活用を加速させる。  ワークショップや専門的なセッションを主導し、製品の基本から高度な機能まで幅広く支援。  導入におけるリスク（技術利用の低さや統合の障壁など）を特定し、顧客の期待を管理しながら問題を迅速に解決。  導入計画や進捗を文書化し、関係者間の連携を維持。  顧客の戦略的・戦術的な意思決定を支援し、Ciscoの検証済み設計を取り入れて長期的な製品利用を確実にする。   【必須（MUST）】    ※以下のいずれか２−３つ     流暢な日本語（必須）  エンタープライズネットワークプロトコル（OSPF、BGP、IS-IS、LISP、VxLAN）に関する専門知識。  Catalyst Center（自動化・保証）、SDA、SDWANの実務経験。  ネットワーク自動化やスクリプト（Python、Perl）による複雑な導入障壁の解決能力。  技術コンサルティングや顧客対応の経験が7〜10年以上。  工学またはコンピュータサイエンスの学士号（修士号が望ましい）。  CCIE資格が望ましく、Cisco Certified Success Specialist資格も推奨。  ネットワーク分野における専門的な知識と導入課題への対応力。      【歓迎（WANT）】     修士号または同等の経験。  CCIE、CISM、CISSPなどの高度な資格複数。  Cisco Certified Success Specialist資格が強く推奨される。  業界コミュニティへの貢献経験（フレームワーク共有、講演、論文発表など）。  シニア技術者の育成やチーム全体の能力向上への貢献経験。  ネットワーク、セキュリティ、クラウド＆AIインフラの複数分野にまたがる幅広い知識。    ※こちらは本ポジションの概要を表した日本語版です。さらなる詳細は以下の英語版をご覧ください。   Meet the Team   The Cisco Customer Experience (CX) organisation is one of Cisco’s fastest-growing teams, with a clear purpose: helping customers get real, lasting value from their Cisco investments. We work at the crossroads of technical knowledge and business understanding, partnering with customers to improve how they operate and achieve outcomes that matter to them. The Customer Success Specialist (CSS) team is a collaborative group of technical advisors who bring deep product knowledge and a genuine curiosity about customer success; We work side-by-side with customers to guide them, not from the sidelines. We are part of a global community that shares adoption approaches and learning across three areas of focus: Networking, Security, and Cloud & AI Infrastructure. title: Chief Architect
description:
Chief Architect

Remote - US

Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.

This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making

Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.

  • Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction.
  • Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.
  • Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.
  • Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.
  • Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.
  • Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of our data modeling frameworks, performance tuning, and technical decision-making

Requirements

  • Strong SQL experience with a deep understanding of analytical modeling concepts

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (models, tests, docs, macros)

  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or ClickHouse

  • Understanding of data modeling patterns

  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts (ELT/ETL, orchestration, version control, CI/CD)

  • Experience with data quality frameworks or implementing validation logic

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Today, our SMB sales motion is dialed in. The majority of new customers find us; they visit our website, start a trial, or request a walkthrough of the platform. We’ve built a process that converts these visitors into customers at an impressive rate.

Over the past year, our product has become increasingly competitive for support teams at larger companies (100-1,000 employees), but those prospects don’t always arrive on our site ready to engage. That’s where you come in.

This is a true outbound sales role, designed for a rep with world-class prospecting skills. You’ll have the opportunity to not only craft our outbound sales motion, but lead the charge competing (and winning) new upmarket customers at a higher ACV.

Please note: For this role, we are only able to hire in the United States.

In this role, you will

  • Build and own your pipeline. We expect more than 75% of your opportunities to be self-sourced through target account campaigns, account-based targeting, referrals, events. Inbound will support you; it won't fill your calendar.

  • Run full-cycle deals. You'll land the first meeting, run tailored product demos, build compelling business cases, manage commercial negotiations and seal the deal. You own the sales motion (with support from our amazing team).

  • Build a playbook. What works for you becomes the baseline of our upmarket sales motion. You're the first person running it, and will work with GTM leadership to set our strategy for the future.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally

title: Head of Market Growth
description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is entering new markets faster than ever, and we need a leader who can build the repeatable system that turns every new launch into a thriving, self-sustaining marketplace. As our Head of Market Growth, you'll own the strategy and execution behind taking a market from launch to scale by creating exceptional experiences for hosts and members, building a powerful local vendor ecosystem, and establishing the growth flywheel that fuels long-term expansion.

The Person We Are Looking For

You're equal parts builder, operator, and strategist. You love creating order from ambiguity, know how to launch new markets from the ground up, and have a track record of building partnerships and systems that continue producing results long after you've stepped away. You're energized by ambitious growth goals, thrive in cross-functional environments, and enjoy developing teams while solving complex marketplace challenges.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

  • Build Playbooks – Design and continuously improve the repeatable systems, processes, and launch playbooks that allow markets to scale beyond the initial launch phase.
  • Grow Ecosystems – Build national and local partnerships with brokers, lenders, contractors, property managers, photographers, and other vendors that help hosts succeed.
  • Drive Referrals – Create referral engines that encourage members, hosts, and vendors to become active advocates who fuel organic growth.
  • Improve Outcomes – Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Member Experience, and Host Experience to improve occupancy, NPS, move-in quality, and host success.
  • Analyze Performance – Use data to evaluate launch performance, identify growth opportunities, reduce customer acquisition costs, and optimize every market.
  • Lead Teams – Hire, coach, and develop Market Account Executives and ecosystem leaders while aligning multiple departments around successful launches.
  • Test & Learn – Run structured experiments, evaluate results, and continuously improve how PadSplit enters and scales new markets.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • Market Leadership – 10+ years leading marketplace, growth, partnerships, or operations teams, including significant ownership of a business, market, or P&L.
  • Launch Experience – Proven success launching or scaling new markets for a marketplace, franchise, or multi-location business.

description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You’ll Do

  • Become a Tekmetric Marketing Product Expert
  • Develop a deep understanding of the industry we serve and market

title: Junior Content Editor
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re looking for a Junior Content Editor to help keep everything we publish accurate, clear, and polished. You’ll work alongside our senior editors, SEO team, writers, and subject-matter experts to take drafts from rough to publish-ready across our blogs, guides, and marketing content.

This is a great fit if you have a sharp eye for detail, love making sentences better, and want to grow into a more strategic editorial role. You’ll learn how content gets found and cited by search engines and AI tools, and you’ll build real skills in editorial process, style, and feedback.

Please note: This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada.

What You’ll Do

Edit for quality

  • Catch spelling, grammar, factual, and formatting errors before content goes live.
  • Rewrite passive constructions into active voice and replace jargon with plain language.
  • Tighten wordy sentences without losing the point.
  • Check that headings are logical and accurately reflect the content beneath them.
  • Verify stats, claims, and quotes against primary sources, and flag anything unverified.

Apply our style guide

  • Apply Inspira’s house style consistently across punctuation, capitalization, formatting, and tone.

title: Director, People Operations
description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability for a growing global company. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm.

This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own managing the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders.

Responsibilities:

People Operations Leadership

  • Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery.
  • Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support.
  • Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Improve the consistency, quality, and equity of the employee experience across U.S. and international processes while accounting for local requirements and operational complexity.
  • Build scalable documentation, self-service resources, controls, and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable manual work and improve accuracy.
  • Manage key People Operations vendors and partnerships, including service quality, contracts, issue resolution, risk management

title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Engineering
description:
About the Job:

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead LaunchDarkly’s Cloud Engineering team, the team responsible for the foundational infrastructure our products and engineering teams depend on.

Cloud Engineering owns LaunchDarkly’s AWS accounts and networking, multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform and GitOps workflows, CockroachDB operations, disaster-recovery capabilities, and FedRAMP infrastructure posture. The team is small, senior, and recently rebuilt. This is a frontline leadership role for a manager who treats operational health as a top priority, leads calmly through incidents, and creates leverage through software, automation, and reliable paved paths.

In your first year, you’ll lead a marquee infrastructure insourcing program from planning through completion. The program’s cost savings will help fund additional team growth, giving you the opportunity to deliver meaningful business impact while strengthening the infrastructure behind LaunchDarkly’s next stage of scale.

This role combines people leadership, operational ownership, and technical judgment. You do not need to be the most senior individual contributor in the room, but you should be comfortable partnering with experienced engineers, guiding tradeoffs, and creating an environment where the team can do its best work.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a senior Cloud Engineering team, providing clear expectations, coaching, feedback, performance management, and career-development support.
  • Own the operational health of LaunchDarkly’s cloud infrastructure, including incident response, on-call health, service-level objectives, resilience, and disaster recovery.
  • Launch and deliver a multi-quarter infrastructure insourcing program, including sequencing work, managing dependencies, communicating milestones, and ensuring a successful transition.
  • Guide technical priorities and tradeoffs across AWS infrastructure, networking, multi-region Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, datastore operations, and compliance-related infrastructure.
  • Build leverage through software, automation, and paved paths that help product engineering teams use infrastructure safely and independently.
  • Support migrations by providing guidance, patterns, and enablement while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with partner teams.
  • Establish team norms for effective AI-assisted engineering and identify opportunities to reduce operational toil through AI and automation.
  • Maintain team health and continuity through change, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable environment.
  • Partner with Service Frameworks, Core Platform, Revenue Platform, Data Platform, and product engineering teams on shared infrastructure priorities and cross-team dependencies.

title: Capture Manager
description:

We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.

We’re looking for a Capture Manager to join our Growth team, owning the end-to-end capture strategy that turns pipeline opportunities into contract wins across Oddball’s federal portfolio.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead full lifecycle capture efforts from qualification through post-submittal, with an emphasis on full and open opportunities
  • Develop and execute capture plans including win themes, discriminators, competitive positioning, and price-to-win strategy

  • Deep domain experience in VA, CMS, and/or DoD with strong customer relationships and mission understanding
  • Experience leading capture team activities across business development, solutions, pricing, and proposal teams

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
In Brief

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll own full-cycle recruiting across the company, with a primary focus on engineering, data science, and AI/ML, and help us build a recruiting operation that finds and signs top-tier talent efficiently.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. title: Controls Engineer II
description:
The Controls Engineer II, Engineering Services designs and maintains the diagnostic infrastructure ICON's fleet depends on — building troubleshooting tools, guided diagnostics, telemetry-sourced health monitoring dashboards, and data-driven predictive maintenance models that move the fleet from reactive toward condition-based service. This role serves as the escalation point for complex controls failures across Field Engineering and customer teams, and is the technical authority others turn to when standard support can't resolve the issue.

This role is based at ICON’s headquarters in Austin, TX and reports to the Director of Engineering Services.

Responsibilities

  • Design feedback and escalation: Diagnose and resolve complex issues involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet and DeviceNet.
  • Identify and report design, reliability and maintenance problems or software bugs to design and software engineering teams to facilitate root‑cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Network and integration support: Assist with issues related to control system networking, including configuring communication devices and integrating control hardware with enterprise systems. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical and IT teams to ensure seamless integration.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and support: Respond to situations where first‑line support cannot isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning control systems.
  • Field Engineering training: Develop and deliver training for the Field Engineering team on control system operation, maintenance, and configuration — building the technical notes, how-to guides, and reference materials that raise the team's capability to support the fleet independently.

  • Regulatory compliance: Ensure that control systems comply with safety and regulatory standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, IEC) and advise customers on best practices for safe operation.
  • Documentation and knowledge management: Update knowledge base articles, create troubleshooting documentation and share insights with global support teams to build organisational knowledge.
  • Continuous learning: Stay current on emerging control technologies, PLC/HMI software and industry trends to incorporate the latest advancements into support practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in industrial automation or control systems support.
  • Strong working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and control network proto

title: Technical Program Manager

About the role

We're looking for someone who owns delivery - not tracks it, not reports it, owns it.

You'll be responsible for a specific area: games, features, or platform work. From the first conversation about a requirement through to production - you're on the hook for the whole thing.

This isn’t a coordination-only role. We need someone with previous hands-on software engineering, DevOps, release engineering, or similar technical experience who can actively improve and automate the way software is built, tested, and released.

You set the timeline, track it, and communicate changes before people start asking questions. If there's a blocker, you've already seen it. If a release isn't ready, you say so - clearly and early.

You'll look at how work flows through your area and fix what's broken. Not just follow whatever process exists. You'll design something that actually works, iterate on it, and make it better over time.

A key part of the role will be identifying manual steps, bottlenecks, and failure points in development and release workflows, and then building practical automation to remove them. This may include improving CI/CD pipelines, automating release checks, connecting tools through APIs, and developing scripts or lightweight internal solutions.

Quality is yours too. Not QA's problem alone, not the tech lead's problem. You own release readiness: is it tested, is it documented, does anyone know the operational risk. If the answer is no, it doesn't ship.

  • Own and communicate a delivery forecast that stakeholders actually trust

  • Present your view on how delivery should work in your area going forward
