title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the team behind our launch vehicles and propulsion systems. This is a hands-on, primarily onsite role focused on high-quality technical recruitment at pace.

You will partner closely with engineering and business leaders to attract exceptional talent across propulsion, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, electronics, software, manufacturing, operations, and corporate functions. You will be expected to move quickly without lowering the hiring bar, while delivering an outstanding candidate experience from first contact through to offer.

Working as part of a high-performing TA function capable of supporting hyper-growth while protecting and strengthening the quality and density of talent across the company.

Fluent German is essential. A key part of the role will be developing relationships with German institutions, rocketry teams, suppliers, and technical communities.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

title: Product

About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, to orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, to generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

Why Product is the only role that sees the whole thing

"If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.” - Henry Ford

Our FDEs go deeper into a single customer than anyone else at Atira. What nobody can see from inside one account is the shape that all the accounts share. You are the person who cares the most about consolidating solutions and has the technical depth to do something about it, which means you decide what comes in and what does not.

As Atira scales we build industry-specific pods: FDE, AE, BDR and Product Marketer, led by a GTM Engineer. Pods go deep. Product goes wide. Everything a pod learns has to end up in one platform, and you are the reason it does. Make sure we do not chase faster horses.

title: Software Developer (gn) @ Autonomous Navigation Venture, Dresden
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. Find out more about us and other opportunities in our portfolio here.

About Soron Systems

GPS goes dark. Signals get jammed. Most drones fall out of the sky. Ours don't.

Soron Systems is building the navigation brain for autonomous drones that operate where GPS can't be trusted: contested airspace, indoor environments, and GPS denied zones. Born out of cutting edge research at TU Dresden, we've already flown our system under active jamming conditions and proven it works. Now we're going from prototype to product, and we need exceptional engineers to make it happen.

This is a rare chance to join at the ground floor of a deep tech startup solving one of the hardest problems in autonomous systems. You'll write code that flies (literally) and see it tested on real hardware within days, not quarters. If you're excited by computer vision, robotics, and building things that matter, keep reading. description:
Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Zoek je een afstudeerstage en heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing?

We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing.

Wat ga je doen?

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen.

Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals:

  • Vormgeving;

  • Webinarproducties;

  • Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud;

  • E-mail marketing; 

  • Social media; 

  • Deep dive in de analytics;

  • Meedenken in plannen rondom AI.

Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan.

Met wie werk je samen?
Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

title: Meewerkstage: Communicatie
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorg je ervoor dat 800+ collega’s wereldwijd weten wat er binnen Voortman speelt én zich betrokken voelen bij de organisatie? Met verschillende vestigingen, landen, afdelingen en groepen collega’s is dat een mooie communicatie-uitdaging. Want niet iedere doelgroep bereik je op dezelfde manier en niet ieder verhaal vertel je via hetzelfde kanaal.

Als stagiair Communicatie draai je volop mee binnen ons communicatieteam. Je staat midden in de organisatie en spreekt collega’s van allerlei afdelingen: van productie en engineering tot service en sales. Je ontdekt wat er speelt, haalt verhalen en ontwikkelingen op en denkt mee over hoe we die op een interessante en relevante manier onder de aandacht brengen bij onze verschillende doelgroepen. Daarbij werk je met allerlei vormen van communicatie en content. De ene keer schrijf je een artikel of werk je mee aan een magazine, de andere keer denk je mee over een video of ondersteun je bij de communicatie rondom een grote interne bijeenkomst voor honderden collega’s. Je kijkt steeds naar wat je wilt vertellen, wie je wilt bereiken en welke vorm daar het beste bij past.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • verhalen en ontwikkelingen ophalen bij collega’s uit verschillende delen van de organisatie;

  • helpen bij het plannen, voorbereiden en publiceren van content (tekst, video, offline materialen);

  • ondersteunen bij de organisatie en communicatie rondom grote interne bijeenkomsten;

  • nieuwe formats en creatieve manieren bedenken om verhalen binnen Voortman te vertellen;

  • kijken hoe we sterke interne content slim kunnen doorvertalen naar externe middelen voor bijvoorbeeld employer branding;

Je doet dit natuurlijk niet alleen. Je werkt nauw samen met het communicatieteam en onze collega’s van Market

title: Stage: Optimalisatie van planningsrapportages
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen onze organisatie speelt planning een belangrijke rol in het realiseren van projecten, het optimaal benutten van capaciteit en het bewaken van voortgang. Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je hoe de rapportagefunctionaliteiten van ons huidige planningspakket beter kunnen worden ingezet om de kwaliteit van besluitvorming en de betrouwbaarheid van de planning te verbeteren.

Je brengt in kaart welke rapportages en dashboards momenteel beschikbaar zijn, hoe deze worden gebruikt en waar de informatiebehoefte van verschillende gebruikersgroepen ligt. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met planners, projectmanagers, productie en management. Door interviews, analyses en praktijkonderzoek ontdek je waar kansen liggen om rapportages te verbeteren, te standaardiseren en te automatiseren.

Op basis van jouw bevindingen formuleer je concrete aanbevelingen waarmee gebruikers sneller kunnen sturen op capaciteit, productieprestaties en projectvoortgang. Je levert daarmee een directe bijdrage aan een efficiëntere planning en betere managementinformatie.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Informatica, Data Analytics of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Interesse in data-analyse, rapportages, KPI's en procesverbetering;

  • Een analytische en gestructureerde werkwijze;

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

title: Senior Implementatie Consultant SaaS, €4.250 – €6.000 | Breda

title: Key Account Manager
description: Vacature Key Account Manager    Fresh Connection is een bekende naam binnen de logistieke sector. Onze klanten kennen ons vooral vanwege één ding: service. Service zit in ons DNA en dat merken klanten iedere dag opnieuw. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, snel schakelen en altijd dat stapje extra zetten.  Door onze groei zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste en ondernemende Key Account Manager die samen met ons verder wil bouwen aan de toekomst van Fresh Connection.  Wil jij werken binnen een ambitieuze organisatie waar klanttevredenheid voorop staat? Zoek je een omgeving waar jouw ideeën worden gewaardeerd, waar je écht impact kunt maken en waar volop ruimte is voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou!      De functie   Als Key Account Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor een eigen portefeuille van strategische klanten. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt, bouwt duurzame relaties op en zorgt ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord en geholpen voelen.  Je begrijpt wat klanten nodig hebben, denkt proactief mee over oplossingen en weet commerciële kansen om te zetten in langdurige samenwerkingen. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat afspraken worden nagekomen en verwachtingen worden overtroffen.      Wat ga je doen?   ·        Bestaande key accounts beheren en verder ontwikkelen.   ·        Langdurige relaties opbouwen met klanten, leveranciers en interne stakeholders.   ·        Commerciële kansen en marktontwikkelingen signaleren en omzetten in concrete groei.   ·        Onderhandelen over prijzen, volumes, contractvoorwaarden en serviceafspraken.   ·        Offertes en commerciële afspraken opstellen, opvolgen en bewaken.   ·        Nauw samenwerken met interne afdelingen.       Wie ben jij?   ·        HBO werk- en denkniveau.  ·        Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een B2B-omgeving.  ·        Sterke communicatieve en onderhandelingsvaardigheden.  ·        Klantgericht, ondernemend en resultaatgedreven.  ·        Analytisch sterk en commercieel scherp.  ·        Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.  ·        Ervaring binnen AGF, food, logistiek of handel is een pré.      Wat bieden wij?   ·        Een uitdagende functie met veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.  ·        Werken in een dynamische en internationale omgeving.  ·        Marktconform salaris.   ·        Laptop, telefoon.   ·        Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden.  ·        Een enthousiast team met korte lijnen en een informele sfeer.      Waarom deze functie?   Omdat jij niet alleen klanten beheert, maar echt impact maakt. Je bouwt mee aan groei, ontwikkelt strategische partnerships en bent een belangrijke schakel in het succes van onze organisatie.  Interesse?  Stuur je CV en motivatie naar hr@freshconnection.nl of neem contact op voor meer informatie met Sharon Kucharek – 00316-18832339  Word jij onze nieuwe Key Account Manager? title: Mobile Growth Manager - CRM (Braze)

title: Logistics Executive
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
description:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

  • Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

  • Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

  • Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

  • Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

  • Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

  • Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

  • Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kunden

title: Technisch Support Engineer

Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen.

Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken.

Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken.

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

  • Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken.

description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Marketing (m/f/d)
description:
Your priority for 2027 is pipeline. You turn marketing into a predictable source of qualified pipeline in two motions. Net new: winning new enterprise logos in Europe and the US. Expansion: growing with our existing clients into new business units, countries, and use cases, with a pipeline target you share with Customer Success and Account Management. Brand, content, and events all matter, and each is measured by what it contributes to these two motions. In the interview process, you will walk us through how you would build this pipeline in your first 12 months.
Tasks

Requirements

Benefits

About the role (Munich, onsite):

You take over our marketing team and own pipeline growth, for net new logos and across our existing enterprise client base. Retorio roughly triples in size every year, sells to large enterprises, and already generates around 40% of its pipeline organically. Your mandate is to build a scalable lead generation engine that works in Europe, our home market where we want to be the clear number one, and in the US, where we have opened an office in New York.

You do this with deliberately modest ad budgets and a small team (today one events specialist and one lead generation specialist) that will grow over time. Our growth strategy is to let our customers speak for us: reference stories, video case studies, and communities in which decision makers at large enterprises share their use cases and results and attract their peers.

To support that pipeline, you also establish Retorio as the credible, science-based voice in an increasingly competitive AI sales coaching category, and you give the brand an external appearance that is professional enough for enterprise buyers and distinct enough to stand out. You report directly to the founder/Co-CEO.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Manager to sit at the centre of how Moss plans, tracks and steers growth. Working with senior management and functional leaders, you’ll connect strategic and operational decisions to the company’s financial objectives, in a business that combines B2B SaaS and payments economics.

You’ll report to the Director of FP&A and join an agile Finance team. The role gives direct exposure to commercial planning, board and investor reporting, and the data layer behind both.

Your responsibilities

  • Own go-to-market and revenue planning end to end across revenue streams, markets, channels and customer segments, turning plans into bottom-up targets with the Commercial team

  • Analyse acquisition and retention economics to show what drives growth and profitability and what does not, then recommend where to invest, how to price and which segments to prioritise

  • Partner with business stakeholders to assess functional performance, weigh risks and opportunities, and shape initiatives that move key metrics

  • Build and maintain financial models for target setting, budgeting, long-term planning and rolling forecasts, and run the planning processes with stakeholders across the company

title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
description:
WEBSITE GROWTH & CRO MANAGER
Berlin, Deutschland · Vollzeit

Die Rolle

Wir suchen einen analytisch starken, umsetzungsorientierten und unternehmerisch denkenden Website Growth & CRO Manager (m/w/d), der die Verantwortung für unsere Websites übernimmt und sie zu leistungsstarken digitalen Vertriebskanälen weiterentwickelt.

In dieser Rolle treibst du Verbesserungen auf unseren Websites, Landingpages und Conversion-Funnels voran. Dabei verbindest du datengetriebenes Experimentieren mit einem guten Gespür für UX/UI, überzeugenden Texten und einem tiefen Verständnis für das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen.

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) Wärmepumpen
description:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Installationsunterstützung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung von innovativen Wärmepumpen-Systemen bei unseren Kunden

  • Unterstützung unserer Installationspartner bei der reibungslosen Integration in bestehende Heizungsanlagen sowie technische Beratung vor Ort

  • Planung, Auslegung und kontinuierliche Optimierung hydraulischer Anbindungen

  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen sowie Durchführung von Reparaturen im Außendienst

  • Präzise Dokumentation aller Arbeitsschritte und Durchführung verständlicher technischer Einweisungen für Kunden und Partner

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
description:
We find your position.

ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung.

Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System.

Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer.

Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken.

Nach vorn ist viel Platz: weitere Branchen, neue Produkte auf der bestehenden Plattform, internationale Märkte, ein stärkeres App-Geschäft. Was zuerst gebaut wird, entscheidest du mit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Entwickler, der das System seit Jahren betreut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

  • Volle Verantwortung für Produkt und Technik: Architektur, Roadmap, Code
  • Rund zwölf Monate übergibt dir der Entwickler das System persönlich, anschließend leitest du den Bereich Product & Technology
  • Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was modernisiert wird und was neu entsteht
  • Neue Produkte und Anwendungsfälle auf der bestehenden Plattform mitgestalten
  • Kundenprojekte von der Aufwandsschätzung bis zum Go-live, inklusive Geräte- und Ortungsanbindung (TCP/UDP, XML)
  • Normkonforme Weiterentwicklung (DGUV, DIN VDE V 0825, CE) und Störungsanalyse im laufenden Betrieb

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Java: drei Jahre professionelle Entwicklung
  • SQL

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Construction is one of the largest industries in the world, yet it is inefficient, wasteful, and incredibly complex. Rising cost pressure and increasing complexity are pushing the industry to its limits. At comstruct, we are on a mission to fundamentally change how construction companies operate and we are looking for people who want to build that future with us.

comstruct develops autonomous AI agents that reimagine the entire material procurement process, from requisition to posted invoice. Our platform takes over repetitive and error-prone tasks across the material flow, enabling construction companies to focus on what truly matters: building. Backed by a €12.5M funding round with investors such as Google Ventures and 20VC, we are now entering our next growth phase and are looking for exceptionally driven and ambitious individuals to help scale our product.

Trusted by some of the world's largest construction companies (including Vinci), we are just getting started. To take our product to the next level, we are looking for a Head of Engineering who wants to build both the platform and the team behind it, at the intersection of AI, software, and one of the most complex industries in the world.

As our engineering team grows past 10 people across three teams, we need a technical leader who can own hiring, coaching, and org design end-to-end — freeing our CTO to focus on building and discovery, while making sure every engineer has the structure, feedback, and growth path to do their best work.

🚀 What we are looking for:

- You have 6+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time in high-growth startups or scale-ups

title: Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München.

Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung.

Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.



Unsere Mission

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt.

Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit.

title: Account Executive - Mid-market
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

description:
Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾

Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do.

The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

HELPLINE est spécialisée dans l’infogérance du support utilisateur et la mise en œuvre d’une expérience collaborateur augmentée par l’IA, où l’expertise humaine et la technologie s’enrichissent mutuellement. Ses équipes assurent le support utilisateur, le support applicatif, le support de proximité, la gestion des actifs IT et la GRC (Gouvernance, Risque et Conformité).  Sa mission est double : soutenir les besoins opérationnels des DSI et des métiers ; et offrir aux collaborateurs une expérience fluide et fiable, alignée avec les standards des marques grand public.  Intervenant en France et dans le monde, HELPLINE compte 2500 collaborateurs au service de plus de 200 clients. Elle affiche un CA de +200 M€ en 2025.  HELPLINE fait partie d’Everience, groupe international de conseil et de services numériques augmentés, pionnier de la symbiose Homme-IA en entreprise.   Description Du Poste   Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos prestations en infogérance, nous recherchons un  Delivery Manager (H/F)  pour notre centre de service à Marcq-En-Barœul.    Ce Que Nous Allons Accomplir Ensemble     Manager et Accompagner les équipes de Service Desk ou de proximité dans l’atteinte des engagements contractuels ;   Relayer la politique RH de l’entreprise auprès des collaborateurs ;   Organiser et Optimiser le support et les ressources du dispositif de production en cohérence avec le contrat commercial ;   Assurer le suivi opérationnel de la relation avec le client, préparer et animer les comités de pilotage ;   Etre garant du déploiement des processus ;   Accompagner à la conduite de changement (plan de progrès, plan d’amélioration,...) ;   Garantir le respect des engagements de service et de la rentabilité financière de la prestation.     En résumé : la notion de pilotage opérationnel de l'expérience utilisateur de nos clients (support, service de proximité, ingénierie du poste de travail, activité de logistique et de gestion de parc) représente la base essentielle de votre mission.    Qualifications     Vous possédez une expérience significative dans le pilotage d’une ou de plusieurs prestations d’infogérance (multi-clients / multi-compte) dans une des activités de support (proximité ou IT ou Helpdesk) et dans le management d'équipe.   Vous avez une bonne connaissance des mécaniques de production et du pilotage financier d'une prestation et/ou d'un compte client.    Vous maîtrisez le référentiel de bonnes pratiques ITIL.   Votre sens du service client, vos qualités de leadership, de communication, d’analyse et de rigueur, alliées à votre capacité à proposer des solutions seront les moteurs de votre réussite.   Rémunération entre 39 K€ et 42 K€ brut annuels.    👉 Vous vous retrouvez dans ce descriptif de poste ? description: Location   Remote in Europe, ideally Zurich or London. Travels up to 30%. Reports to the CEO.   Albatross   Albatross builds perception models: AI that understands human behavior and powers product discovery the way a great salesperson does, by observing the customer and adapting in real time. LLMs understand words. We understand behavior.  Our models power discovery for 50 million+ shoppers a month. The results are public. Wallapop: +119% homepage engagement, +35% overall engagement. OfferUp: +84% homepage engagement, +20% overall engagement.  One platform, four primitives: discovery feed, similar items, playlist, contextual search. A customer goes live in seven weeks. The pipeline is global, we are deployed in 12 countries.   About The Job   Our results sell Albatross. Your job is to get every customer to them, fast, and turn them into revenue. You own everything after signature: the seven weeks to a live A/B test, the result the customer can measure, the conversion to a long-term contract, the renewal, and the growth after it, use case by use case and marketplace by marketplace. Maintain that trust and bring them fast to the results.  The platform is the product: four primitives, one platform, configured, not coded. You make sure customers use what we built, as designed. Every customer that goes live without custom code is a customer we can scale to. Your team is what lets us add customers without adding engineers, and it is never the bottleneck.  We want a builder. Today the founders and the data scientists run deployments. You take that over, build the Deployment Strategist team that runs it, and turn it into a machine: one strategist per five customers, every customer on all four primitives.  You own the customer. Sales hands over at signature and does not take it back. You will:    Own every customer relationship after signature, as the senior point of contact for their CPO, VP of Data and VP of Engineering  Run every pilot to a result: live A/B test in seven weeks, uplift measured, contract converted  Keep customers on the platform: primitives and platform components as designed, configuration over custom code. When a customer asks for bespoke work, you find the way to do it with what exists, or you say no  Own renewals and upsells: every live customer to all primitives, and group agreements rolled out to every marketplace the group owns. You handle customer QBRs and show impact  Own customer support: one front door, fast answers, incidents handled with the customer informed before they ask  Hire, build and lead the Deployment Strategist team across Europe and the US. title: Enhetschef till Kundservice, VO Hjälpmedel i Kristianstad
description: Gör skillnad. Varje dag.  Vill du genom ditt ledarskap bidra till Region Skånes vision, framtidstro och livskvalitet, för alla som bor och verkar i Skåne? Som chef i Region Skåne är du en del av den offentliga sektorn och kraften i ledarskapet hittar vi i samarbeten med chefskollegor och närmaste chef. Tillsammans med dina medarbetare skapar du engagemang, når resultat och driver utveckling.  Hjälpmedel är ett verksamhetsområde (VO) inom förvaltning Psykiatri, habilitering och hjälpmedel med ansvar för samtliga hjälpmedelsområden som finansieras av Region Skåne. Här ingår hjälpmedel till personer med rörelse-, syn-, hörsel-, kommunikations- och kognitionsnedsättningar, medicinska behandlingshjälpmedel, ortopedtekniska hjälpmedel samt läkemedelsnära produkter Hjälpmedelsverksamheten består av två områden, ett för patientnära arbete samt ett område för order och logistik. Område order och logistik som ansvarar för order- och materialflödet i hela verksamheten består av fyra enheter: Kundservice, Verksamhetsstöd, Sortiment och Logistik.  Kundservice finns i Kristianstad och hanterar beställningar av förbrukningsprodukter inom inkontinens, speciallivsmedel och diabetes. Kundservice tar emot samtal från förskrivare och patienter i hela Region Skåne samt ansvarar för inkommande telefoni och mejl för hela hjälpmedelsverksamheten. Enheten ansvarar även för handläggning av hjälpmedelsanvisningarna.  Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta som chef i Region Skåne: https://www.skane.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-hos-oss/utvecklas-med-oss/ledarskap-som-gor-skillnad/   Arbetsuppgifter   Som enhetschef för Kundservice ansvarar du för att leda, utveckla och följa upp verksamheten med fokus på kvalitet, tillgänglighet och kundnöjdhet. Du har ett helhetsansvar för verksamhet, ekonomi, arbetsmiljö och medarbetare. En viktig del av uppdraget är att skapa goda förutsättningar för utveckling, där du genom ett närvarande ledarskap coachar, ger feedback, följer upp mål och resultat, främjar samarbete och skapar ett gott arbetsklimat. Tillsammans med dina medarbetare utvecklar du verksamheten genom effektiva arbetssätt med hög kvalitet och följer upp kontinuerligt för lärande och vidareutveckling.  Kundservice har en central roll i verksamheten och ansvarar, utöver beställningar, stöd och service, även för handläggning av hjälpmedelsanvisningar. En viktig del av ditt uppdrag blir därför att säkerställa hög kvalitet och effektivitet i både kundservice- och handläggningsprocesser samt att utveckla verksamheten utifrån kundernas behov.  Du ingår i ledningsgruppen och förväntas bidra aktivt till verksamhetens gemensamma uppdrag. Som medlem i ledningsgruppen tar du ansvar för helheten och bidrar till gemensamma beslut, även när de sträcker sig utanför den egna enheten. Du ser värdet av att skapa och utveckla samarbeten både inom områdets ledningsgrupp och över hela verksamheten, med fokus på gemensamma prioriteringar, helhetsperspektiv och med kunden i fokus.

title: Bliv privatkundechef i Lokalbank Hillerød i en foreningsejet Nykredit-koncern
location: Hillerød, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du lede 11 dygtige privatrådgivere og gøre en forskel for kunder, kolleger og forretningen i Lokalbank Hillerød? Og deler du vores mål om, at det skal være TRYGT, UDFORDRENDE og SJOVT at gå på arbejde? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.   Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som privatkundechef.   Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver   Du får det daglige ledelsesansvar for 11 privatrådgivere og bliver en del af bankens ledergruppe, som består af lokalbankdirektøren, erhvervskundechefen, en privatkundechef og dig. I ledergruppen har vi et tæt samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper og udvikler hinanden på tværs. Sammen sætter vi retning, følger op på mål og skaber rammer, hvor rådgiverne kan lykkes – til gavn for kunderne, medarbejderne og forretningen. Drive Lokalbank Hillerøds forretningsudvikling gennem høj aktivitet og målrettet opfølgning.  Skabe et solidt samarbejde med erhverv, Private Banking og øvrige fagligheder på tværs af huset og koncernen.      Er det dig, vi leder efter?   Du kan være en erfaren leder eller ny i lederrollen. Det afgørende er, at du har en bankfaglig baggrund og ønsker om at gøre en mærkbar forskel for kunder, kolleger og forretningsudviklingen. Du er tydelig og nærværende, skaber resultater gennem andre og kombinerer høje ambitioner med tillid, humor og plads til forskellighed. Samtidig har du blik for helheden, tager initiativ til fælles løsninger og formår at samle forskellige fagligheder om kundernes behov og lokalbankens fælles mål.  Til gengæld får du udvikling, muligheder og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi vil hinanden og lykkes sammen.   Dit nye team   I Lokalbank Hillerød er vi 38 kolleger på tværs af privat, totalrådgivere og erhverv. Vi har samtidig et tæt samspil med Private Banking og andre kolleger i koncernen, der ofte bruger vores lokaler. Du bliver leder for 11 privatrådgivere og får en central rolle i at styrke samarbejdet, kundeoplevelsen og Lokalbankens udvikling.  Vores mål er klare: Det skal være TRYGT at være sig selv, UDFORDRENDE at udvikle sig og SJOVT at være en del af holdet.  Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.   Vil du vide mere?   Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, lokalbankdirektør Kim Lüning på tlf. 27 62 92 30, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Kim Lüning | LinkedIn.  Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.   Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

title: Account Manager
description: ← Back to careers  Account Manager  PMNow | Fully Remote | Home Services Digital Marketing   About PMNow   PMNow (Proven Marketing Now) is a 20-person digital marketing agency. Since 2020, we’ve done one thing: get the phone ringing for home services businesses (plumbers, HVAC contractors, and electricians) across the United States.  Our services: Local SEO, Website Development, Google Ads, and Social Media Management.  We’re not a generalist agency. Our clients look remarkably alike: same services, same buyer urgency, different cities. That focus is our advantage, because what we learn on one account we can apply to ninety-nine others.  The Role  You’ll be the main point of contact for a group of home services clients. You’ll own each relationship, make sure our work delivers results, and keep clients with us.  Our clients are busy business owners, not marketers. They want to know whether the phone is ringing, and they want a straight answer.  You’ll have an established process, documented standards, and a team of specialists in SEO, ads, web, and social. Your job: make sure their work lines up with each client’s goals, explain results clearly, and turn at-risk accounts into long-term partners.  You’ll work with: SEO, Ads, and Web specialists, and leadership on retention and growth.  What You’ll Do  Client Relationship    Be the main point of contact for your assigned clients  Lead monthly performance meetings in plain language  Prepare reports that connect our work to calls, leads, and revenue    Account Oversight    Review and proofread specialist work before it reaches the client  Guide specialists on technical SEO and oversee audit implementation  Find and fix account issues before they affect performance    Day-to-Day Support    Respond quickly to client requests and concerns  Bring in specialists when needed    Retention and Growth    Spot chances to grow accounts and recommend services that fit  Step in to calm down and resolve issues between clients and the agency    What We’re Looking For    Agency account management: You’ve managed a book of digital marketing clients and can show how you kept and grew them.  Strong SEO knowledge: You can tell good work from bad and explain the difference to a client.  Clear communication: You can explain a drop in ranking to a plumber in two sentences.  Confidence in hard conversations: You deliver bad news honestly and steer toward solutions.  Organization: You keep many accounts moving without letting anything slip.  Ownership: You don’t wait to be told when an account is at risk.  Commercial instincts: You notice when a client is ready for more, or about to leave.  Playbook discipline: You bring good ideas and follow our standards consistently.  Tools: ClickUp, Slack, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile.    Nice to Have    Experience with home services clients (plumbing, HVAC, electrical)  Familiarity with Google Ads, Local Services Ads, and call tracking

title: Strategic Business Development Manager

description: Kan du omsætte markedsindsigt til nye kunderelationer og konkrete forretningsmuligheder?  Hos SolarFuture søger vi dig, der vil udvikle vores Utility Scale-forretning inden for PV og BESS i Danmark og Norden. Du identificerer de rigtige projekter og etablerer relationerne tidligt, så SolarFuture kommer i spil til relevante udbud. Vi arbejder med solenergi, batterilagring og energiinfrastruktur og samarbejder med blandt andre projektudviklere, investorer og energiselskaber om at realisere fremtidens energiprojekter.  Vi er i en spændende vækstfase, hvor vedvarende energi, energilagring og fleksibilitetsløsninger spiller en stadig vigtigere rolle i den grønne omstilling. Som en del af vores team får du mulighed for at arbejde med spændende projekter og være med til at styrke SolarFutures position inden for Utility Scale PV og BESS i Danmark og Norden.  Du bliver en del af et professionelt og ambitiøst team med stærke kompetencer inden for teknik, projektudvikling, projektering og kommerciel udvikling. Vi lægger stor vægt på samarbejde, vidensdeling og personlig udvikling.     Dine arbejdsopgaver  Du kombinerer analytisk arbejde og markedsindsigt med opsøgende kontakt. Du skal både analysere data og selv tage telefonen, booke møder og følge op. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:   Identificere kommende PV- og BESS-projekter og nye geografiske markeder, følge projekterne frem mod Ready-to-Build (RTB) og udbud samt analysere kunder, konkurrenter og markedsmuligheder.  Have det operationelle ansvar for opbygning og vedligeholdelse af vores Utility Scale-database og pipeline i CRM, herunder datakvalitet, prioritering, udvikling af dashboards og rapportering til CCO.  Skabe kontakt til udviklere, IPP’er, investorer og energiselskaber, deltage i indledende kundemøder og koordinere kundebesøg, konferencer og netværksaktiviteter.  Udarbejde markeds- og konkurrentanalyser, følge udviklingen inden for relevant lovgivning og regulering samt omsætte denne viden til strategiske analyser og beslutningsoplæg for CCO og direktionen.  Forberede vores kommercielle direktør (CCO) til strategiske kundemøder, udarbejde analyser og beslutningsoplæg til CCO og direktionen samt koordinere møder og opfølgning.  Bidrage med markeds- og kundeindsigt til Bid/No Bid og Commercial Win Strategy og sikre en struktureret overdragelse til tilbudsorganisationen.      Din profil  Du er analytisk og struktureret og kan omsætte komplekse informationer til kommercielle anbefalinger. Samtidig er du nysgerrig, relationsskabende og naturligt opsøgende i din kontakt med nye kunder og samarbejdspartnere.  Du arbejder sikkert med CRM

title: Sähkön työnjohtaja
description: Sähkön työnjohtaja, palveluliiketoiminta, Helsinki       Haluatko johtaa sähköalan ammattilaisten tiimiä, jonka palveluun asiakkaat ovat poikkeuksellisen tyytyväisiä (NPS 75)? Haemme nyt vahvasti kasvavaan palveluliiketoimintaan sähkön työnjohtajaa vastaamaan huoltoautotiimin toiminnasta.      Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi vahvaa joukkuetta, jolla on erinomainen tekemisen meininki ja kasvun vaihde päällä. Olemme markkinan kärkitoimija valikoiduilla osa-alueilla, mutta emme tyydy siihen, vaan haluamme kehittää toimintaamme yhä seuraavalle tasolle.      Työtehtävän kuvaus   Tehtävässäsi tulet vastaamaan ammattitaitoisen asentajatiimin päivittäisestä johtamisesta, jossa korkea palvelutaso ja asiakastyytyväisyys ovat keskiössä. Sähkön työnjohtajana huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaidemme toimeksiannot hoidetaan laadukkaasti, turvallisesti ja sovitusti. Työsi sisältääkin mm. asentajaresursointia, asentajien ohjeistamista ja laskutusta.     Pääset myös työskentelemään asiakasrajapinnassa ja oleellisena osana työtäsi on asiakkaan tarpeen ymmärtäminen, tarjouslaskenta ja myynti. Roolisi onkin tärkeä osa palveluliiketoimintaa ja sen kasvua.      Odotamme sinulta   Tässä roolissa odotamme sinulta sähköalan koulutusta ja kokemusta alalta, mutta ennen kaikkea onnistumisesi ratkaisee can do -asenne. Sinulla on draivia kehittää toimintaamme yhdessä muun organisaation kanssa. Arvostamme uusia ajatuksia ja sitä, että uskallat tarttua asioihin, joita voisimme tehdä vielä paremmin.     Toivomme, että:   Sinulla on kokemusta työnjohdosta ja/tai esihenkilötehtävistä  Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisellä työotteella  Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot  Pystyt organisoimaan ja priorisoimaan tehtäviä muuttuvissa tilanteissa  Haluat kehittää sekä omaa että tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti paremmaksi.      Katsomme eduksi olemassa olevat verkostot toimialalta ja insinöörin tutkinnon.     Ennen kaikkea etsimme joukkoomme ihmistä, joka innostuu sekä ihmisistä että asiakkaista. title: Service Lead (North)
description: He aha ai tātou – Why us?   At One NZ we’re not just imagining the future, we’re building it. Our purpose? A better-connected Aotearoa New Zealand.  Kia renarena te taukaea i Aotearoa New Zealand.   Our ambition? To become the most AI-enabled telco on the planet. This isn’t just about our technology, It’s about you. We’re investing in our people like never before.... empowering them to grow, lead, and shape what’s next.  Through our AI School, access to world-class learning platforms, or career pathways that evolve with you, we create an environment where your curiosity thrives, and your skills accelerate.  Join us and be part of something extraordinary: connect with purpose and help redefine what’s possible.   Ko tō tūranga – your role   As our Service Lead, you’ll be a leader of leaders, shaping the frontline experience across our Consumer and Business segments while empowering leaders to build capable, engaged and high-performing teams. You’ll balance strategic thinking with operational delivery, translating direction into action, leading through change and ensuring our people are set up to deliver great experiences for our customers.  At the heart of this role is people leadership. You’ll coach and develop leaders, build capability, lift performance and create genuine ownership and empowerment across our Arohia Contact Centre teams. Working closely with key stakeholders and our offshore partners, you’ll also bring together strong operational knowledge, strategic thinking and a real passion for developing people and shaping how we deliver service for our customers. This is a hybrid role based from our Tāmaki Makaurau Support Office in Auckland’s Wynyard Quarter.   Ko Tō Mahi – What You’ll Do     Lead day-to-day operations and coach frontline leaders across Consumer and Business journeys, driving performance, engagement, wellbeing, and a culture of accountability, inclusion, and customer obsession.  Champion a customer-first culture by embedding service excellence programs, ensuring consistent, personalised experiences across all teams and partners, and aligning nationally and globally on customer delivery.  Oversee daily service performance, drive adoption of new initiatives, and close capability gaps through targeted coaching and training to ensure consistent, high-quality customer outcomes.  Drive customer satisfaction and efficiency by meeting key service metrics and partnering on strategies to boost productivity and experience.  Ensure timely communication of key initiatives and represent Voice & Messaging in cross-functional forums to support alignment and execution.  Lead recruitment across both the North and South Islands and ensure smooth onboarding by fostering early connections between new hires and team leaders.     Na Tōu Rourou - What You’ll Bring     Customer Centricity: Deep commitment to delivering great experiences for customers and frontline teams. Unapologetic about getting things done for the benefit of our Customers

title: Service Delivery Manager – Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description: Job Description    At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.     About Us   Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We put citizens and patients at the center, simplifying everyday life for all, and providing the tools required to transition towards increased self-and preventive care and lower cost-of-care settings.  We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.   About The Role   At Tieto Caretech’s Data Driven Care unit we are reshaping healthcare and social care services by providing our customers with data-driven solutions. Our team consists of high-end professionals working in platform development, data science, data engineering, data modelling, cloud solutions, security and software development.  We are a growing international team of talented, continuously improving experts. With us you get to work with latest technologies, innovative new solutions and create wellbeing for the society.  As a  Service Delivery Manager  in our team, we expect you to have a strong will to lead data-driven service deliveries in complex technology environment and bring new value to our customers through pioneering solutions. To succeed in this position, you need to have previous experience in service deliveries in area of data-driven solutions.   In this role you will be responsible for:     Leading service deliveries and act as a key contact person towards customers  Your focus will be in service deliveries in Swedish- and German-speaking European markets  Ensuring the success of our customers in their operations with our deliveries  Continuous development of our operations together with colleagues in delivery management, product management and development teams  Building relationships inside the organization to promote active collaboration     To succeed in this role, you should have:     Service delivery management experience of data centric solutions.  Fluent ITIL knowledge.  Fluency in Swedish and/or German, as well as English, is required for this role.  Experience of data platforms and cloud environments  Experience of healthcare industry     As a person you:     Have a capability to lead technically complex service deliveries with multiple teams and stakeholders

title: ERP Service Level Manager/in (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben   Für unser Kundenservice-Team suchen wir ab sofort einen  ERP Service Level Manager (m/w/d) in der Schweiz . Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für unsere Bestandskunden und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Anliegen schnell und effizient bearbeitet werden. Dabei kümmerst du dich um die Koordination und Kommunikation zwischen Kunden und unserem Team.Deine Aufgaben umfassen:    Du bist verantwortlich für die Betreuung unserer langjährigen Bestandskunden und bearbeitest dafür Serviceanfragen.   Du überwachst das Budget, stimmst den Aufwand sowohl intern als auch mit dem Kunden ab und übernimmst die Termin- und Ressourcenplanung.  Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe der Aufgaben an die Bearbeiter und gibst den Kunden zur weiteren Vorgehensweise regelmäßig Feedback. Damit sorgst Du für die nötige Transparenz.  Für einen optimalen Ablauf gestaltest Du die internen Prozesse wo immer nötig neu und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung der neuen Kommunikationswege zum Kunden und intern.     Dein Profil   Du verfügst mindestens über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, idealerweise im kaufmännischen, technischen oder IT-Bereich. Darüber hinaus bringst du mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer koordinierenden Rolle mit. Besonders wichtig sind uns:    Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden, verstehst deren Bedarfe und kannst mit deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten jede Situation erfolgreich meistern.  Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und Planungsgeschick, viele Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft zu halten.  Du hast bereits Erfahrungen mit ERP Systemen gesammelt, kennst die Vorteile und Schwachstellen und weißt, wie man solche Systeme ideal nutzt.  Du bist bereits mit APplus vertraut? Hervorragend! Du nutzt eher andere ERP Systeme? Kein Problem, dann kannst du dich schnell in APplus einarbeiten.  Du hast durchaus auch Spaß daran ab und zu unsere Kunden vor Ort zu besuchen (ca.10% Reisebereitschaft).  Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (Schweizerdeutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.     Unser Angebot     Vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld in dem Du Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein Potenzial langfristig einbringen kannst.  Intensive Einarbeitung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für Deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildung in unserem hauseigenen Trainingscenter sowie die Betreuung durch eine/n Mentor/in.  Flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamarbeit und Spaß an der Arbeit großgeschrieben werden.  Flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit Mobile Office und einem leistungsgerechten Gehaltspaket sowie modernen Büros ausgestattet mit der neuesten Technik.  Regelmäßige persönliche Meetings mit dem ganzen Team – Teamwork wird bei uns Großgeschrieben.  Den Arbeitsalltag bereichern wir mit Benefits wie Betriebsfeiern und Teamevents, Fahrradleasing sowie Mitarbeiter-Rabatte. description: Manager, Customer Success, Multi-Asset Trading, Southern Europe   As a Manager of the Trading Customer Success Team for Southern Europe, you'll lead a dynamic team of 7-8 individual contributors, playing a pivotal role in shaping the retention and customer experience for LSEG’s Trading Workflow clients.  Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Success, Sales & Trading EMEA, you'll be an integral part of the EMEA Customer Success Leadership Team, where your insights and leadership will drive impactful strategies and elevate our customer success initiatives.  The successful candidate will focus on ensuring clients realise the full value of our platforms to achieve their business goals through the creation of success strategies that drive adoption, integration, and expansion.    Leadership Activities:     Lead and develop a team of high performing  CSMs with deep trading industry expertise.    Develop the CSM strategy for the Trading proposition (KPIs, marketing, community, playbooks) and ensure execution of regional and global CSM programs.   Create the strategy to recruit diverse talent, onboard, and develop existing talent to achieve the Customer Success mandate and drive employee engagement.    Develop a culture of customer success, accountability, and collaboration across key stakeholders: sales, customer operations, and product strategy.    Collaborate with regional and global peers to share best practices and create community.    Provide thought leadership to shape the CSM organisation at the proposition, regional and global level.      Customer Advocate:    Build strong client relationships to understand the market needs and drive voice of the customer internally for all decision making.  Collaborate with the wider Customer Success leadership team, product strategy and sales enablement to ensure the voice of the customer is aligned to retention campaigns and product strategy.    Drive awareness of the Customer Success team and value proposition with clients.  Participate in industry events for both Clients and Customer Success, be a brand ambassador for LSEG and bring trends back into the business to shape the organisation.    Commercial Engagement:    Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure retention campaigns and talent are aligned to drive positive renewal outcomes.  Collaborate with Sales and Customer Operations to ensure smooth hand offs in customer journey for optimal renewal and expansion outcomes.    Monitor and report on the overall customer health, adoption metrics, renewals, expansion opportunities and execution of Customer Success Plans.    Collaborate with product strategy to ensure upgrade, migration, and adoption campaigns are launched and achieved.    Identify opportunities / risks and areas of improvement to the Sales and Account Management leadership team and align on actions to address.    Success Metrics in Role:    Usage  Retention    Annual Subscription Value  Revenue Growth  Adoption KPIs   Custom

description: Om oss  Inom avdelningen Affärsoptimering ansvarar vi för kundrelationen med våra kunder inom elnät. Vi har ett proaktivt arbetssätt som syftar till värdeskapande och partnerskapsorienterat samarbete med våra kunder. Vårt mål är att skapa värde genom personlig kontakt, kvalificerad rådgivning och genom att stötta våra kunder i strategiska och långsiktiga beslut.  Din roll  I den här rollen kombinerar du Customer experince (CX) med operativt kundarbete. Det innebär att du möter kunder, fångar deras behov och omvandlar insikterna till konkreta förbättringar i våra digitala verktyg, arbetssätt och kundmöten. Rollens tyngdpunkt är CX och kundutveckling, samtidigt som du ansvarar för en mindre kundportfölj.  Du arbetar bl.a. med:    Bygga relationer med företagskunder och föra löpande kunddialoger  Genomföra kundintervjuer och analysera återkommande behov, friktioner och trender  Bygga en struktur för hur kundinsikter fångas upp och tas tillvara i alla kundmöten  Följa upp användning och kundfeedback i våra digitala tjänster  Omsätta kundinsikter i konkreta förbättringsförslag och driva utvecklingen tillsammans med interna specialister  Presentera insikter internt och vara kundens röst i verksamheten     Dina erfarenheter  Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av kundupplevelse eller användarcentrerad tjänsteutveckling och som är van att självständigt samla in och omsätta kundinsikter till praktiska förbättringsåtgärder. Vi ser gärna att du har förståelse för account management och långsiktigt kundarbete. Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund inom CX med erfarenhet av kundansvar, eller inom account management med tydlig och praktisk CX-kompetens.  Du behöver inte vara specialist inom energibranschen, men vi ser gärna att du har god förmåga att ta till dig teknisk information och på sikt kunna leda grundläggande kundmöten om exempelvis abonnemang, effekt och energianvändning. Erfarenhet från en teknisk eller komplex B2B-verksamhet är meriterande.  Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, initiativtagande och strukturerad. Du trivs med att vara nära kunderna, vågar ifrågasätta befintliga arbetssätt och driver idéer från insikt till förbättring. Du samarbetar gärna med andra och tror, precis som vi, på att vi vinner tillsammans och att nyfikenhet på teknik hjälper oss att skapa bättre kundlösningar.  Hur är det hos oss?  Vårt team leds av Andreas och består av personer med olika bakgrund, erfarenhet och ålder, vilket skapar en bred kompetens och olika perspektiv i arbetet. Vi arbetar nära varandra i teamet och i tätt samarbete med andra avdelningar. Här finns både lång erfarenhet och nyare perspektiv, men även ett gemensamt fokus på att utveckla kundrelationen.  Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 4 november 20206.  Är du redan anställd inom E.ON? Då ber vi dig söka tjänsten med din jobbmejl.  För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef:  Andreas Svensson, andreas.svenss

title: Product Specialist – Histology/Pathology
description: Oslo area preferred | Field-based | Home-based     We are exclusively supporting an established European MedTech company looking for a Product Specialist – Histology/Pathology to develop its business in Norway.     The company provides specialist equipment and technologies to hospitals and diagnostic laboratories, with a particular focus on pathology and histology.     The Norwegian market offers considerable opportunity for further development, and this position will play an important role in expanding the company's customer base and strengthening its presence.  The role is primarily focused on sales and business development, combining commercial responsibility with specialist laboratory knowledge.      The Role   You'll take responsibility for developing the Norwegian market, working independently while receiving support from an experienced Nordic team.  Your responsibilities will include:   Developing new business and building relationships with hospitals and pathology laboratories.  Managing existing customer relationships and identifying opportunities for growth.  Identifying and managing hospital tenders and public procurement opportunities.  Introducing laboratory equipment and solutions to customers.  Understanding laboratory workflows and identifying suitable technologies.  Managing sales activities, CRM pipeline and forecasting.  Working closely with Nordic colleagues across sales, product management and technical support.       Who We're Looking For   We're open to different professional backgrounds, including:      Sales or Product Specialists working with pathology, histology or laboratory equipment.  Medtech, IVD or diagnostics sales professionals with experience in hospital procurement, tenders or business development.  Biomedical Scientists or laboratory professionals with strong pathology or histology experience who have the right commercial mindset and approach and are interested in moving into a commercial role.      You'll need good communication skills, confidence working with customers and the motivation to develop new business.     Norwegian and English language skills, a driving licence and willingness to travel regularly are required.  Previous sales experience is valuable, but we're equally interested in speaking with laboratory professionals who have the right personality and motivation to move into industry.      What You Can Expect    Responsibility for developing your own market and customer relationships.  An established international organisation with specialist expertise in laboratory technologies.  A varied role combining customer visits, technical discussions and commercial development.  Independence in planning your working week and managing customer activities.  Home-based working, supported by colleagues across the Nordic organisation.  The opportunity to develop your commercial experience and work with different hospitals and laboratories.  Pension contribution, paid phone and internet, and reimbursement

description: Vil du være med på å utvikle en av Norges mest spennende virksomheter?      Vi søker en  teknisk og kommersielt orientert Konsulentsjef i Oslo, med sterk teknisk kompetanse.  I denne rollen vil du være en sentral person i Unicus sin utvikling.  Unicus er et annerledes IT-konsulentselskap. En ting som gjør Unicus annerledes er at alle våre konsulenter har Autisme Spekter Diagnose (ASD). Vi er stolte av våre konsulenters unike styrker, som høy evne til konsentrasjon, strukturert og analytisk tenkning, sterke evner innen mønstergjenkjenning og et øye for detaljer. Vi fokuserer på hvordan vi kan skape verdi av disse unike styrkene.  Unicus ble etablert i 2009 og er nå en internasjonal virksomhet under navnet auticon i 13 land med over 400 ansatte. Vi jobber med spennende kunder som DNB, Statnett, Kongsberg-gruppen og DNV i Norge, har en solid økonomi og Ferd som vår hovedeier.      Hvem er du?    Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, leveranser og forretning. Du har solid teknisk kompetanse, kommersiell forståelse og evnen til å støtte og utvikle vårt talentfulle team av konsulenter.   Du vil både jobbe med kommersiell utvikling av vår kundeportefølje og delta selv på noen prosjekter som f.eks. Løsningsarkitekt eller Tech Lead. Vi tror derfor at den rette kandidaten har utdanning og/eller solid erfaring innen IT – for eksempel innen softwareutvikling, Data Engineering, Data Science eller AI.   Som Konsulentsjef vil du være et sentralt bindeledd mellom kundene og konsulentene våre og bidra til høy leveransekvalitet, langsiktige kundeforhold og identifisering av nye forretningsmuligheter. Rollen er sentral i videreutviklingen av Unicus sitt tjenestetilbud og posisjon i markedet.   Vi tror at du har lyst til å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, det kommersielle og det å løse et samfunnsproblem. Du stimuleres av kundedialoger og liker å jobbe med mennesker. Du bør ha erfaring som leder (personal, prosjekt eller faglig) og liker å jobbe i en liten og smidig organisasjon, med raske beslutninger og mulighet til å sette ditt preg på virksomheten.    Vi er et IT-konsulentselskap som verdsetter mangfold. Du trenger ikke erfaring med autisme fra før, men du må være en person som synes det er spennende å bidra i andre menneskers utvikling.        Ditt daglige ansvar som konsulentsjef    Vi er en liten organisasjon, og vi samarbeider tett. Du vil rapportere til daglig leder og få nødvendig hjelp og støtte i oppstartsfasen fra resten av teamet i Norge. Du vil også ha mulighet til å hente kunnskap fra våre søsterselskap i 13 land.
