Headquarters:  San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
 

 In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes,   Powers of Ten   traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.    
 That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable. 
 We’re looking for a  Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative , a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work. 
  Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting.  What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling. 
  You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing.  Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off. 
 You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

 In your first year, your focus will be roughly  70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

title: Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über YUVENDA

Die YUVENDA Gruppe ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter für innovative Softwarelösungen, die den Mittelstand im Einzelhandel, in der Gastronomie und in konsumnahen Dienstleistungen stärken. Basierend auf best-of-breed Softwaremodulen, unterstützen wir unsere Kunden mit benutzerfreundlichen Lösungen, die einfach zu kombinieren und implementieren sind und die mit ihren Anforderungen mitwachsen.

Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir ab sofort einen Digital Marketing Manager (m/w/d) in Festanstellung (unbefristet).

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Business Unit POS & Payment Solutions (YUVENDA POS und YUVENDA Pay). Gleichzeitig verantwortest du über alle Business Units hinweg das Social & Community Management, unsere Marketing Automation Plattform und E-Mail-Marketing. Du berichtest an den Head of Marketing.

Kurz gesagt: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Reichweite Leads werden – und aus Leads echte Pipeline.

Deine Aufgaben als Digital Marketing Manager

Business Unit Partner POS & Payment Solutions

  • Du bist die zentrale Marketing-Ansprechperson für Sales, Customer Success und Produkt rund um YUVENDA POS und YUVENDA Pay.

  • Du baust echtes Domain-Wissen auf: Zielgruppen, Use Cases, Wettbewerb und Branchenthemen in Handel und Gastronomie.

  • Du planst die Kampagnen-Roadmap der Business Unit – abgestimmt auf Produkt-Releases, Messen und Events.

  • Du übersetzt die Ziele der Business Unit in konkrete Briefings für Content, Social und E-Mail.

  • Du verantwortest den Pipeline-Beitrag deiner Business Unit: Leads, MQLs und SQLs.

Social & Community Management

  • Du entwickelst die Kanalstrategie je Business Unit: Plattform, Frequenz und Ziel.

  • Du erstellst Redaktions- und Postingpläne und setzt sie aus bestehenden Content-Assets um.

  • Du managst unsere Community: Komment

title: Werkstudent (M/W/D) Planning & Control
description:
Wir begeistern unsere Kunden weltweit mit unseren innovativen Produkten und Serviceleistungen und schaffen Mehrwerte für Mensch und Umwelt. Als traditionelle mittelständische Unternehmensgruppe mit über 300 Kollegen und Kolleginnen an 6 Standorten im In- und Ausland forcieren wir unser internationales Wachstum und unseren Wandel hin zu einem modernen, werteorientierten und menschenzugewandten Unternehmen mit flacher Hierarchie und Vertrauenskultur und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung des Teams im Bereich Planning & Control im operativen Tagesgeschäft
  • Pflege, Aufbereitung und Auswertung von Daten, Reportings und Kennzahlen
  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Analysen und Präsentationen
  • Mitwirkung bei der Planung und Nachverfolgung interner Prozesse und Projekte
  • Unterstützung bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben
  • Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen

Qualifikation

Du bist eingeschriebener Student im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und interessierst dich für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sowie analytische Aufgabenstellungen. Du verfügst über ein gutes Zahlenverständnis sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel. Außerdem bringst du ein gutes koordinatives und kommunikatives Verständnis sowie Interesse an abteilungsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Planung, Controlling oder Datenanalyse gesammelt. Zudem besitzt du gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig. Wenn du Interesse daran hast, Praxiserfahrung im Bereich Planning & Control eines international tätigen Industrieunternehmens zu sammeln, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Ab sofort kannst du bei uns im Rahmen einer Werkstuden

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) - gern auch Quereinsteiger!
description:
Werde Teil von HC24 und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des möblierten Wohnens auf Zeit.

Seit fast 40 Jahren stehen wir für persönliche Beratung, verlässlichen Service und individuelle Lösungen. Mit 13 Standorten deutschlandweit bringen wir Menschen und Wohnraum zusammen – professionell, unkompliziert und persönlich.

Für unsere Niederlassung in Ulm suchen wir dich als Unterstützung in der Kundenbetreuung – gerne auch als Quereinsteiger (m/w/d).

Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit Menschen, bist serviceorientiert und organisierst gerne? Dann passt du zu uns.

Aufgaben

Das erwartet Dich

Als Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) bist Du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere nationalen und internationalen Kundinnen und Kunden. Du begleitest sie von der ersten Anfrage bis zum Einzug und sorgst mit Deiner freundlichen und professionellen Art für ein rundum positives Kundenerlebnis.

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen hierbei:

  • Persönliche und telefonische Betreuung unserer internationalen und nationalen Kundinnen und Kunden

  • Beratung bei der Suche nach möbliertem Wohnraum auf Zeit

  • Erstellung von Mietvertragsentwürfen

  • Kommunikation mit Vermietern und Mietern vor, während und nach der Mietzeit

  • Organisation und Durchführung von Wohnungsbesichtigungen sowie Wohnungsübergaben

  • Allgemeine Büro- und Organisationstätigkeiten

Qualifikation

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung

  • Du bist eine offene, freundliche und kommunikative Persönlichkeit

  • Du besitzt eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein Klasse B

title: Homeoffice Kundensupport (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
description:
Über Simplyright

Wir bei Simplyright helfen unseren Kunden dabei, ihr Recht schnell und unkompliziert durchzusetzen. Unser Fokus liegt unter anderem darauf, unzulässige Kontogebühren von Banken zurückzufordern oder zu viel gezahlte Beiträge während des Lockdowns von Fitnessstudios zurückzuholen. In unserem Team mit 11 bis 50 Mitarbeitenden arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, juristische Prozesse für Verbraucher zugänglich zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben im Backoffice

  • Du bearbeitest Kundenanliegen und administrative Vorgänge im Innendienst.

  • Du pflegst und verwaltest Kundenakten im System.

  • Du stehst im telefonischen Austausch mit Mandanten und betreust sie bei Fragen zu ihren Verfahren.

  • Du korrespondierst schriftlich über unser Ticketsystem mit Kunden.

Das bringst du mit

Für diese unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Wochenstunden bringst du Organisationstalent und Zuverlässigkeit im administrativen Bereich mit. Wenn du dich in den Aufgaben wiederfindest und nicht jede einzelne Anforderung zu hundert Prozent erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Deine ersten Monate bei Simplyright

In den ersten Monaten wirst du dich intensiv in unsere Abläufe im Backoffice einarbeiten, Kundenakten eigenständig bearbeiten und den direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten übernehmen. Du lernst unsere internen Systeme kennen und unterstützt das Team tatkräftig bei der Durchsetzung von Kundenansprüchen.

Vergütung und Benefits

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Gehalt im Rahmen von EUR 2,500–2,800 per month. Du profitierst von flexiblem Homeoffice und kannst komplett remote arbeiten. Zudem unterstützen wir dich mit bezahlten Krankheitstagen und zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen.

title: 3D Data Operator (w/m/d) | 3D Scans to Digital Twins of Real Factories
description:
Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts.

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

Your daily work

  • Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows.

  • Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing.

  • Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others).

  • Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results.

  • Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues).

  • Track and report your weekly processing output.

  • Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges.

What we are looking for

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care.

  • Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done.

title: Technical Business Development Intern (Emerging Verticals) (f/m/d)
description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where.

Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

Zum Angebot gehören ein Büroarbeitsplatz in Berlin mit teilweiser Homeoffice-Möglichkeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Weiterentwicklung des Onboardings

About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer who’s passionate about using AI to change how teams across the business get their work done.

You’ll embed with a team, learn how they actually work, and build the AI-powered workflows that make them faster and more effective. You start by mapping how the function operates today, then decide together with the team where AI can create the most value and build it.

This is not a support role, a solutions-engineering role, or staff augmentation. You are a full engineer who works at the boundary between our AI platform and a business domain. You ship production systems, and the best of what you build for one team becomes a reusable capability for the whole company.

You Will:

  • Embed with a team. Work alongside a function for sustained periods, joining their day-to-day so you understand how they really operate.

  • Map how the work gets done. Build a clear picture of the function's current workflows and surface where time, handoffs, rework, and manual effort pile up.

  • Find where AI creates the most value. Prioritize the opportunities that will move the function's outcomes the most, and align with the team on what to tackle.

  • Build it in production. Ship real, AI-powered workflows that solve the problems you find, working hands-on with the team and our platform.

  • Scale what works. Turn proven solutions into reusable capabilities so a win with one team accelerates the whole organization.

About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

About DITTO

DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial.

Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action.

You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale.

  • Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets.

  • Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works.

title: Embedded Software Designer

Wij zoeken per direct een Embedded Software Designer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van slimme technische oplossingen en complexe softwarevraagstukken? Dan past deze rol bij je.

Als Embedded Software Designer werk je binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen aan innovatieve projecten met hoge kwaliteitsnormen. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces: van requirements en architectuur tot implementatie en testing. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers en krijgt volop ruimte om jouw technische kennis verder uit te bouwen.

Als Embedded Software Designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van embedded softwareoplossingen. Je stelt technische architecturen op, ontwikkelt software in C en/of C++, en test de werking van systemen. Daarnaast integreer je verschillende softwaremodules en zorg je voor duidelijke documentatie.

Je werkt aan projecten binnen Embedded Linux, RTOS of OS-less omgevingen en schakelt regelmatig met collega’s uit andere disciplines.

Hoe je impact maakt

Je bent een belangrijke schakel binnen het ontwikkelteam en zorgt ervoor dat softwareoplossingen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig zijn. Door jouw inzet verlopen projecten soepel en worden technische uitdagingen succesvol opgelost. Je draagt bij aan innovatieve producten en de groei van het team.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Salaris: €3.750 - €5.500 bruto p/m, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Goede begel

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
De uitdaging

Wij zoeken per direct een Software Test Engineer voor ons zusterbedrijf Veynex in de regio Limburg / Brabant. Haal jij voldoening uit het waarborgen van softwarekwaliteit en het continu verbeteren van testprocessen? Dan past deze rol bij je.

Als Software Test Engineer werk je samen met product owners, domeinexperts en ontwikkelteams aan het opstellen van heldere en effectieve testplannen. Je zorgt ervoor dat software op alle niveaus van de stack grondig wordt getest en zet actief in op testautomatisering. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige testproces en draagt bij aan het verbeteren van softwarekwaliteit binnen multidisciplinaire ontwikkelomgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Test Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van testprocessen. Je stelt testplannen op, scherpt requirements aan waar nodig en zorgt ervoor dat tests efficiënt worden uitgevoerd.

Je gebruikt scripts en geautomatiseerde testtools om software te testen, valideert testresultaten en rapporteert bevindingen aan stakeholders. Daarnaast ontwikkel je verificatieplannen, kwaliteitsborgingsprocedures en teststrategieën. Door continu te zoeken naar verbeteringen in processen en automatisering help je het team om softwarekwaliteit sprint na sprint te verhogen.

title: PLC Software Engineer

title: Test Engineer
description:
Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!?

Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer:

  • Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten.

  • Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester.

  • Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen.

  • Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant.

  • Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc.

  • Technisch challengen: niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant.

Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt.

Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten.

Wat ga je, onder andere, doen?

  • Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen.

  • Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s.

  • Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies.

  • Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits.

  • Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming.

  • Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties.

As a Senior C++ Firmware Engineer, you will take technical ownership of software subsystems within advanced Test & Measurement products. You will contribute to the integration of mmWave converter functionality, development of calibration-related features, firmware verification, and enhancement of VNA measurement capabilities up to 170 GHz.

You are comfortable working with large existing software architectures and can effectively analyze, modify, and extend complex instrument software while maintaining product quality and performance.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong C++ development capabilities with practical understanding of RF measurements, calibration concepts, and automated verification methodologies.

title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP

Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later).

Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren.

Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen.

title: wo-stage statistiek: data-analyse en weegmethoden

Op zoek naar een statistiekstage?
Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen.

Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. description:
About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering).

About the role

As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months.

What you will do:

  • Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing

  • Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months

  • Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor

  • Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation

  • Test and iterate with our Boston biology team<

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

title: ML Platform Engineer
description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE

We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.

You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team.

The role is based in Paris and is on-site.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScri

considers those the same job.

mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

title: Stagiair(e) Grafisch Ontwerp | AI-First | Zero Trust | Geen Brave Marketing
description:
AI is geen toevoeging. AI is je vertrekpunt.

Zonder AI werken is geen optie meer. Bij ON2IT gaan we nog verder: we bouwen een werkwijze waarin AI het vertrekpunt is, niet een hulpmiddel. Jij ook?

Als grafisch ontwerp stagiair(e) ga jij samen met ons ontdekken hoe jouw vak eruit ziet als je AI niet toevoegt aan je proces, maar er vanuit begint. Wat betekent dat voor creativiteit? Voor strategie? Voor jouw toekomstige rol?

Die vragen beantwoorden we niet voor je. Die beantwoord je zelf, terwijl je ze leeft.

Wat ga je doen?

Je maakt visuele concepten voor ON2IT marketingmaterialen, van social media en websites tot campagnes en video. Maar je vertrekpunt is altijd AI. Je test welke tools je proces versnellen, welke je output scherper maken, en waar jouw creatieve oordeel het verschil maakt.

Je bouwt geen portfolio van mooie plaatjes. Je bouwt een nieuwe manier van werken.

Je begint elk project met de vraag hoe AI je denkproces, je output en je snelheid versterkt, en pas daarna hoe jij als creatief mens de doorslag geeft waar AI tekortschiet. Je test, je experimenteert, je bouwt werkwijzen die er vorig jaar nog niet waren.

Jij geeft ON2IT's cybersecurity positionering een frisse, scherpe uitstraling, met tools en methodes die onze sector nog niet kent.


Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je studeert grafisch ontwerp, multimedia of een verwant veld (minimaal 3e jaar).

  • Je bent actief nieuwsgierig naar AI in het ontwerpproces, kritisch en hands-on, niet bang.

  • Je combineert creatief instinct met strategisch denkvermogen.

title: Senior PHP/Go Developer

In today’s world, cybersecurity is an integral part of everyday life. Companies need to be prepared for anything; at any moment a threatening situation can arise. Together with your colleagues (currently 8 developers and testers), you build small projects in containers. Those projects together form the software solution on which ON2IT’s entire business runs. We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast.

Everything is completely taken care of; we just ask you to put away your plate in the dishwasher after. title: Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow.

In a nutshell

  • Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed).

  • Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale.

  • Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics.

  • Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression.

  • Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events.

About Kaizo

At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing.

The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
Senior Marketing Manager

Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible)
Competitive salary
Start date: as soon as possible

Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet.

We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework.

The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret.

  • The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story.

  • We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up.

  • Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation.

  • We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events.

  • Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs.

  • Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it.


That’s where you come in.

What this role really is

We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who:

  • Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search.

title: Medior/Senior Softwareontwikkelaar C#/.NET

title: (Senior) Toezichthouder Digital Operational Resilience (DORA) Capital Markets
description:
Als (Senior) Toezichthouder DORA binnen het team Market Infrastructure of Trading Venues speel je een cruciale rol in het toezicht op de digitale weerbaarheid van de kapitaalmarkten. Jij beoordeelt of handelsplatformen, proprietary trading firms en clearing‑ en settlementinstellingen voldoen aan de Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), en of hun IT‑processen voldoende robuust, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn. DORA vraagt dat instellingen hun IT‑risico’s effectief beheersen, incidenten snel en transparant oplossen, regelmatig testen of systemen bestand zijn tegen cyberdreigingen en risico’s in de keten en uitbesteding scherp onder controle houden. Jij helpt hen daarbij én houdt scherp toezicht op naleving. Samen met je collega’s ontwikkel en borg je een impactvolle toezichtstrategie voor digitale weerbaarheid binnen de kapitaalmarktinfrastructuur. Je leidt onderzoeken, gaat in gesprek met instellingen en stakeholders, en volgt technologische en marktontwikkelingen op de voet. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met nationale en internationale toezichthouders zoals DNB en ESMA en ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor marktpartijen. Je draagt bovendien bij aan beleidsontwikkeling en kunt je expertise inzetten bij projecten binnen verschillende teams. Kortom: jouw werk heeft directe impact op de stabiliteit en digitale veerkracht van de financiële markten.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Toezicht houden op de digitale weerbaarheid van de kapitaalmarkten

  • Onderzoek leiden en uitvoeren naar DORA‑compliance bij kapitaalmarktinstellingen

  • Uitwerken van een meerjarige DORA‑strategie

  • Fungeren als aanspreekpunt voor (internationale) marktpartijen

  • Bijdragen aan beleidsontwikkeling binnen kapitaalmarkten

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders zoals DNB en ESMA

title: Data Engineer Kapitaalmarkten
description:
Als allround Data Engineer binnen de afdeling Datagedreven Kapitaalmarkten (DAK) ontwerp, bouw en beheer je betrouwbare datapipelines en datasets voor het toezicht op de kapitaalmarkten. Daarnaast help je onze ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen en het gebruik van Databricks verder te professionaliseren. Je ontsluit, structureert en prepareert gegevens voor data-analisten, toezichthouders en andere gebruikers. Binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving werk je met grote hoeveelheden gestructureerde en ongestructureerde data, variërend van miljoenen tot miljarden records. De gegevens bevinden zich onder meer in Databricks, SQL-databases en Azure Storage. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare ETL-processen en zorgt dat data vindbaar, controleerbaar en geschikt is voor analyse en toezicht. Je verbetert de ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen met versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD in Azure DevOps. Met Declarative Automation Bundles leg je Databricks-code, configuraties en resources vast en deploy je deze gecontroleerd naar verschillende omgevingen. Hierbij werk je aan herhaalbare en beter beheersbare wijzigingen en deployments. Bij het ontwikkelen van dataoplossingen pas je de geldende kaders voor security, privacy en governance toe. Je draagt bij aan monitoring en kostenbewust gebruik van het Databricks-platform, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke platform-, architectuur- en securityspecialisten. Daarnaast ontwikkel je duurzame dataproducten en draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling, innovatie en standaardisatie binnen het team.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van processen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en verwerking binnen onze Azure-cloudomgeving en op het Databricks-platform met onder andere Databricks Jobs, Azure Data Factory en PySpark/SQL.

title: Senior contractmanager IT
description:
In nauwe samenwerking met de besluitvormers van de afdeling DTI, manage je de lopende contracten, waaronder strategische. Daarbij gaat het niet alleen om het behalen van financieel resultaat, maar zeker ook om het zorgdragen dat de leverancier levert volgens contractvoorwaarden. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat contracten effectief worden beheerd, bewaakt en nageleefd om optimale resultaten te behalen. title: Toezichthouder cybersecurity Crypto
description:
Als Toezichthouder Cybersecurity Crypto ondersteun je de AFM bij het toezicht op cryptodienstverleners die onder de Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCAR) vallen. Afdeling en Team

title: Senior datamanagement specialist

Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!   The Opportunity   As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at FICO, you'll be a trusted executive partner to some of our most important customers, driving transformational outcomes and sustainable growth across a portfolio of high-value accounts. This is a senior, commercially-oriented role for someone who operates naturally at the C-suite level — someone who can connect FICO's platform capabilities to a customer's most pressing strategic priorities, and turn those connections into long-term, expanding partnerships. You will own the full commercial health of your accounts, serving as the primary driver of retention, expansion, and executive alignment.  This position requires residence in Sydney or Melbourne. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.  We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.  We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.  Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. We’re looking for a  Product Growth Manager  to bridge product development and client success. title: (Senior) Customer Experience & Loyalty Manager (m/w/d)
description: Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife.       Dabei sind unsere  Ökostromtarife nur die Basis . Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit  eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern,  Elektromobilitätslösungen  und der eigenen  Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie .       Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚  Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.     Als Customer Experience Manager (m/w/d) bist du dafür verantwortlich, die langfristige Bindung und Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden und Kundinnen zu stärken, indem du Strategien entwickelst und umsetzt, die das Kundenerlebnis kontinuierlich verbessern und die Kundenloyalität steigern.       Deine Aufgaben    Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Strategien und Ansätze zur Steigerung der Kundenbindung und -loyalität   Erstellung und Optimierung von Kundenkommunikation (z.B. E-Mail-Marketing)   Durchführung von A/B-Tests zur Evaluierung und Verbesserung von Kundenbindungsmaßnahmen   Überwachung und Analyse von Kundenfeedback, um kontinuierlich Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und die Kundenbindung zu fördern   Quantitative Analyse und Auswertung von Kundendaten (mit Excel, SQL, BI-Tools, ggf. Python) zur Identifikation von Trends und Optimierungspotenzialen   Regelmäßige Erstellung von Reports und Dashboards zur Erfolgskontrolle und kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Retention-Maßnahmen   Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Sales und Produktteams, um eine ganzheitliche Kundenerfahrung sicherzustellen        Das bringst du mit     Mind. 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Customer Experience oder Kundenbindung - vorzugsweise in einem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld   Ein Gespür für die richtige Sprache und ein Auge für Layout: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl, setzt gerne Kundenkommunikation auf und passt diese auf Basis von Kundenfeedback kontinuierlich an   Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Analysen und Konzepte verständlich zu präsentieren   Ausgeprägtes strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen, um Prozesse datengetrieben zu optimieren und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern   Hands-on-Mentalität: Du bist in der Lage, Daten zu analysieren, Prozesse zu gestalten und operative Themen eigenständig zu steuern   Erfahrungen in der Datenanalyse, idealerweise mit Excel / Google Sheets und/oder erste Erfahrungen mit SQL und die Bereitschaft, diese Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen   Deutschkenntnisse

You will decide who hears what, when, based on which behaviour, and toward which commercial outcome. Your job is to turn customer behaviour and usage signals into adoption, retention, expansion and reactivation revenue, and to run that engine AI-first, building agents and agentic workflows that do real work.      Who we are   Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.      The role   You will own the lifecycle marketing program for our paying customers: the 30/60/90 onboarding plays, ongoing customer communications, customer segmentation, and the expansion and retention plays that grow and keep the base. You design the journeys, brief the work, QA it and measure it, and you own the revenue outcome.     Three things define this seat.       The number.  Your primary measure is the qualified expansion and cross-sell opportunities Lifecycle generates and surfaces. Expansion revenue, net revenue retention and at-risk recovery sit right behind it, shared with CS, Sales and Product.   The lane.  You own orchestration and outcomes across the customer base, not every surface you touch. PMM owns the message, GTM Ops builds the scoring and routing, and Growth and CS co-define the signals with you. You make it all work together.   The operating model.  This is an AI-first role, and AI fluency is the job. The bar is that you can stand up an agent that does real work, not describe one. Accelerating Time Doctor's AI-first operating model is an explicit expectation of the seat.      This is a systems role. You build repeatable, automated journeys rather than one-off campaigns, and you keep human ownership of segmentation logic, offer design, guardrails, final QA and the commercial call.      Who you are    You treat a revenue number as yours, and you design every journey toward adoption, retention or expansion.  You have high agency. When a journey underperforms, you find out why and fix it.  You are commercially minded. You turn customer signals into revenue.  You are analytical and cohort-fluent. You read behaviour and act on where customers stall or grow.  You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable, automated flow than run another one-off campaign. A strong customer mindset, balancing commercial outcomes with doing the right thing for customers and protecting the long-term health of the business. description: About IRIS   IRIS Software Group is one of the UK's largest privately held software companies, trusted by 100,000+ businesses, schools and accountancy firms to keep their operations running. Our software pays 1 in 6 UK employees, supports over 12,000 schools, and is relied on by 91 of the top 100 UK accountancy firms.  We're a Great Place to Work® certified employer, recognised for our commitment to well-being, inclusion and development - and we're growing fast. The  Customer Marketing Manager, Retention & Advocacy  leads customer-facing communications across key lifecycle moments, including renewals, advocacy and migrations, ensuring customers clearly understand value, change and next steps. The role holds clear ownership of complex customer journeys rather than executing isolated campaigns. Lead customer advocacy activity in the US, securing testimonials, case studies and third-party reviews in partnership with Sales, Product and Customer Success teams.  Own US-specific migration communications, including planning, sequencing, QA, live delivery and performance monitoring.  Act as the single point of accountability for assigned customer journeys, managing accuracy, compliance sensitivity, timing and escalation.  Work closely with UK-based Customer Marketing colleagues to adapt established frameworks for the US market.  Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Renewals, Support, Professional Services and Marketing Operations.  Analyse programme performance and use insight to continuously optimise engagement and retention.  Ensure all customer communications meet IRIS brand, legal and compliance standards.  Share customer insight from the US market to inform product and marketing strategy.     What This Role Is Not     Not an entry-level or junior marketing role.  Not focused on net-new acquisition or demand generation.  Not a task-only execution role without ownership.  Not suitable for candidates without prior customer marketing experience. Het borgen van een uniforme werkwijze rondom service reviews, governance, rapportages, escalaties en contractmanagement.   Het verhogen van klanttevredenheid, klantloyaliteit en contractretentie.   Het ondersteunen van commerciële groei door het actief ontwikkelen van up- en cross-sell kansen binnen bestaande klantrelaties.   Het bewaken en verbeteren van contractperformance, marges en financiële resultaten binnen de SDM-portefeuille.   Het verder ontwikkelen van Service Delivery Management als strategische discipline binnen Interstellar.   Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Service Delivery, Operations, Sales, Finance en de specialistische teams.   Het stimuleren van een cultuur waarin klantwaarde, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering centraal staan.      Meer weten over werken bij Interstellar? title: Senior Full Stack Developer (PHP & Vue.js)
description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 other countries.

How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers.  We're expanding the engineering team, and we need a Senior Full Stack developer who moves across the stack and unblocks whatever's stuck, frontend or backend.


This is what you'll do
You'll join a project squad, consisting out of a Product Owner, UX designer, and fellow engineers, and move across the stack as the work demands it. One day you're deep in a Vue.js3 component, the next you're in PHP8 and MySQL sorting out the backend logic that's blocking the Frontend team. Your job isn't to pick a lane; it's to keep features moving from idea to release for over a million users.

You'll start on tickets, get to know the codebase and how we work, then move onto full projects. We build in six-week cycles, followed by two weeks to reflect and reset. Join early, question assumptions, stay close to the team throughout.

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

Deine Rolle Als Customer Success Manager begleitest du unsere Kundinnen und Kunden vom Onboarding über die laufende Nutzung bis zu den Vertragsverlängerungen. Du bist ihr Bindeglied zu unserem Produktteam und sorgst dafür, dass sie die AlpineAI-KI nicht nur nutzen, sondern echten, messbaren Mehrwert daraus gewinnen.    Deine AufgabenKundenbeziehungen & Account Management •      Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson deiner Kundinnen und Kunden und baust vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehungen auf.  •      Du führst regelmässige Check-ins mit deinen Kundinnen und Kunden durch, verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und unterstützt sie mit Consulting oder Support.  •      Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung der Vertragsverlängerungen in deinem Kundenportfolio und arbeitest dafür eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen.  •      Du hilfst aktiv mit, deine Kundinnen und Kunden als Referenzen zu gewinnen. Onboarding & Enablement •      Du begleitest neue Kundinnen und Kunden durch Onboarding und Rollout – von der Einrichtung ihrer Instanz bis zu Schulungen und Workshops, in denen du auch komplexe Themen verständlich vermittelst.  •      Du analysierst bestehende Arbeitsprozesse, identifizierst gemeinsam mit deinen Kundinnen und Kunden sinnvolle KI-Anwendungsfälle und begleitest deren Umsetzung oder übernimmst sie gleich selbst.  •      Du sammelst Kundenfeedback und bringst es strukturiert in die Produktentwicklung ein. Customer Health & Kundenerfolg •      Du analysierst die Zufriedenheit deiner Kundinnen und Kunden sowie die Nutzung unserer Lösungen und entwickelst mit ihnen konkrete Ziele.  •      Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und gefährdete Accounts frühzeitig, leitest Massnahmen ein und eskalierst intern, wo nötig.  •      Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und Sales und weiteren internen Teams zusammen, um Kundenanliegen rasch zu adressieren.    Dein ProfilWas du mitbringst •      Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit KI-basierten Lösungen oder SaaS-Produkten – im Customer Success Management, im Projektmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle.  •      Du hast bereits in einem Start-up gearbeitet und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen wohl.  •      Du bringst eine hohe Software-Affinität sowie eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe für neue digitale Tools im Arbeitsalltag mit.  •      Du beherrschst Prompt Engineering und weisst, wie man KI-Lösungen gezielt auf konkrete Anwendungsfälle zuschneidet.  •      Du hast Freude am direkten

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.   We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.   Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.   We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.    Tasks    As  a Customer Success Manager  in our conversational AI company, you won't just manage customer accounts – you'll guide them through the entire lifecycle: from discovery and implementation to measurable success with our AI solutions. Your blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and relationship-building talent ensures that customers not only adopt our products but also grow successfully with them.      Main tasks       Onboarding Navigator : Safely introduce new customers to our world of AI/SaaS solutions. Ensure a smooth start with clear implementation roadmaps, milestones, and KPIs.    Solution Implementer : Work closely with customers and internal teams to configure conversational AI bots, automation workflows, and integrations – tailored to the specific use cases and business objectives of the customers.    Testing & QA advocate : Coordinate and oversee UAT (User Acceptance Testing), ensure the quality of the bots, fix problems, and guide customers through test iterations until the solutions meet the agreed standards.    Optimization partner : Continuously monitor bot performance and customer feedback. Suggest improvements, automation optimizations, and best practices to increase efficiency and ROI.    Engagement Conductor : Keep customer relationships active and proactive. Conduct regular business reviews, analyze performance reports, and ensure customers achieve their goals.    Relationship architect : Build strong, long-term relationships – as a basis for trust, success and mutual growth.    Adoption catalyst : Conduct training, enablement workshops and documentation to empower customer teams to use our tools effectively and independently.    Feedback Loop Coordinator : Translate customer feedback and needs into concrete recommendations for action and work closely with the product and engineering teams to further develop our solutions.    Growth Scout : Work with sales to identify renewal, expansion, and upselling opportunities and drive joint growth.

title: Senior Growth Manager, KR
description: Who Are We?  RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.  We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.  RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.  Role Overview  As Senior Growth Manager for Korea at RZR, you will drive revenue growth and client retention across a portfolio of strategic KR accounts — identifying and executing the highest-impact opportunities through growth initiatives and product adoption.  At the account level, this means building strategic growth plans, managing forecasts and pipelines with discipline, and delivering consultative partnerships across client organizations up to executive level. Internally, it means cultivating strong cross-functional relationships, aligning teams, and removing blockers so that growth strategies land with precision and impact in the KR market.  This is an individual contributor role with real ownership from day one. You will not inherit a playbook — you will build one. The right person for this role combines commercial instincts with analytical rigor, earns trust at every level of a client organization, and operates with the independence and accountability of someone who treats their portfolio like a business.  Key Responsibilities  Revenue Retention & Growth    Drive sustainable revenue by growing accounts, preventing churn, and uncovering opportunities that result in long-term growth for each assigned KR account    Client Ownership & Strategy    Own end-to-end account strategy by setting clear growth plans across three key areas: relationship mapping and development, upsell and cross-sell strategies, and short and long-term revenue growth and retention initiatives  Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering data-driven recommendations and fostering product adoption through regular engagement with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership  Develop strategic relationships that generate marketable client wins, gather product and market feedback for internal stakeholders, and maintain a 360° view of each account at all times    Campaign Management & Performance Insights    Ensure campaigns operate seamlessly and optimize effectively through collaboration with Analyst and Product teams, delivering insights that tie performance to real business outcomes    Cross-Functional Co

title: Customer Success Manager
description: About AskYourTeam   Founded in Aotearoa NZ in 2014, AskYourTeam helps leaders listen to their people, customers and communities, then act on what matters most.     Now, more than 200 organisations and governments across New Zealand and Australia use our platforms. VOICE captures and analyses feedback from staff and stakeholders. CODA, our decision intelligence platform, is designed to help councils understand what their community wants, not just the loudest voices.      About the role   Our customers don't buy AskYourTeam to run surveys. They buy it to make better decisions. Your job is to work hand in hand with industry leaders to make sure they succeed.     You'll look after a portfolio of private and public sector customers, from their first login and platform training through to renewal and beyond. You'll report to our Manager, Customer Success, and work closely with Sales, Product and Marketing.     Routine support is self-service and automated, so you won't spend your days in a ticket queue. Most of your time will go into proactively working out what success looks like for each customer and helping them get there. Where there's a genuine need, you'll grow the relationship and articulate the AskYourTeam value. Where there isn't, you won't force it.      A heads-up on what it's like here.    We're a small, growing team, which means:   Not everything has a process yet, some of it you'll write.  Priorities shift sometimes.  You won't always get a tidy brief. You'll be trusted to work out what good looks like and to check in when it matters. But you will always get support from everyone in the company to support our customers.  Everyone pitches in. Getting the right thing done matters more than whose job it was.   If that sounds unsettling, that's completely fine. If it sounds like room for you to move and grow, we'd love to hear from you.      What you'll do    Own the relationship with your customers, from onboarding through to adoption, renewal and account growth  Earn the trust of senior leaders and executive sponsors, by understanding what they're really trying to achieve and not just what they asked for  Build Success Plans with customers, and run regular reviews that show progress and agree what's next  Monitor customer health and act early when engagement, adoption or sentiment changes  Lead renewal conversations and meet agreed retention targets, bringing in Sales or senior leadership where needed  Spot opportunities for additional products and services, focused on what adds value for the customer  Recognise when a customer needs deeper analysis or facilitated workshops, and refer them to our independent partner consultants  Train managers and users so they can use the platform confidently on their own  Bring customer feedback to Product and Technology, and help fix the root causes of recurring issues, not just the symptoms  Help shape how Customer Success works here, including playbooks, processes and resources       What you'll br

title: Client Success Manager
description: Job Description   DXC Technology (NYSE:DXC) - where brilliant people embrace change and seize opportunities to advance their careers and amplify customer success. People are the heart of our business. We support each other and work as a team, globally and locally to deliver excellence for our customers and colleagues. We live in more than 70 countries, speak multiple languages and work with over 6,000 customers on almost every continent. We use the power of technology to deliver technology services that move the world. DXC.com  We are looking for an experience  Client Success Manager  to join the team in Auckland.    Client Success Managers (CSMs) are responsible for delivering revenue growth in 1 or more client accounts.  For their client, they are the key representative the delivery organisation and are responsible for coordinating all activities and personnel within their account(s).  CSMs are core to the development and delivery of strategic objectives and financial goals. At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
